segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: I’m glad you came, Randy.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah!

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏓᎴᏂᎲ … ᎯᎢ ᏥᏂᏓᏛᏁ … ᎯᎢ ᏗᎾ,ᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᎩ, ᏥᏓᎾ,ᏕᎶ,Ꮖ ᎠᎭᏂ, ‘ᏢᏴ ᏛᎾ,ᎴᏅᎯ, ᎠᎾᏛᏓᏍᏗᎲ ᏙᏳ, ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ, ᎤᎾ,ᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ, ᎨᎮᏍᏗ, … ᏓᎾ,ᏕᎶ--ᏍᎩ’Ᏼ ᏩᎾ,ᏟᎢᎶᎦ, ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎬ -- ᏐᎢ’Ꮕ, ᎨᎲ ᏗᎨᏣᎵᏏ, ᎠᎴ ᏍᏊ Ꮝ-Ꮝ-ᎩᎶ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᏙᏢᏒ ‘ᏢᏴ ᏳᏚᎳ, ᎨᎮᏍᏗ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ,ᏛᎪᏗ ᎨᎲ … ᏍᎩᎾ ᏱᎨᎦᎵᏍᎪᎳ,ᏓᏌ, ᎨᎮᏍᏗ, ᏳᎾ,ᏛᏁ,Ꮧ -- ᎢᎾᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᎨᏒ ᏲᏁᎦ, ᎬᏗ, ᏕᏣᏙᎠ ᏍᎩᏃᎯᏌ
segments.transliteration: adalenihv … hii tsinidadvne … hii dina,delo,quasgi, tsidana,delo,qua ahani, ‘tlvyv dvna,lenvhi, anadvdasdihv doyu, osda, tsalagi, gawonihisdi, una,dvdasdodi, gehesdi, … dana,delo--sgi’yv wana,tliiloga, anelisgv -- soi’nv, gehv digetsalisi, ale squu s-s-gilo sidanelv itsadotlvsv ‘tlvyv yudula, gehesdi hiwonisgv una,dvgodi gehv … sgina yigegalisgola,dasa, gehesdi, yuna,dvne,di -- inalenisgv gesv yonega, gvdi, detsadoa sginohisa
segments.translation: To begin, what we’re doing here, these students that are going to school here, they will start listening and learn the right way to speak Cherokee. I guess they thought the students will get that far. And the other reason, your grandchildren or someone from your family, someday they might decide they want to learn. They would allow them to use this recording. To begin, tell me your English name.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Randy Duncan.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: And in Cherokee?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Usinvd(a).

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Where were you born?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎠᎭᏂ, Ꮎ ᏓᎵᏆ, ᎾᎮᎾ, ᎠᏩᏛᏒᎢ’Ꮕ, ᏗᏢ, Ꭴ-ᎤᎭᎸᏂ ᏗᏢ,
segments.transliteration: ahani, na daliqua, nahena, awadvsvi’nv, ditlv, u-uhalvni ditlv,
segments.translation: I was born here in Tahlequah, but I grew up in Bell.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Were you born in the old hospital?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah, it was the old one.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎤᎾ ᎤᎭᎸᎾ ᏗᏢ, Ꮟ--… ᏗᏣᏛᏏᏗᏎ ‘Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏕ?
segments.transliteration: una uhalvna ditlv, si--… ditsadvsidise ‘do usde?
segments.translation: There in Bell, where you grew up, what was it like?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ) ᎤᏲ’Ꮫ ᏥᏃᎦᏛᏅ ᏂᎦᏓ,’ᏛᎡ Ꮭ Ᏺ’ᎠᏅ,Ꮤ, ᎤᏲ ᏃᎦᏛᏅ y’know ᎤᎵᎮᎵᏍᏗ, ᎨᎲ ᏙᏳ, Ꮎ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ‘ᎣᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᎣᎩᎩᏍᏗ, ᏥᎨᎲ y’know? … ᏂᎪᎯᎸ’Ꭱ ᎦᏚ ᏓᏝᎲ … ᏚᏯ’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, ᏄᎾ,’Ꮕ, … ᏂᎬ’Ꮽ ᎣᏣᏛᏁᎵᏙᎲ ᏙᏣᏁᎶᎲᏍᎬ … ᏂᎦᏓ, ᎾᎥ ᎠᏂᏁᎳ, ᎠᏂᏧᏣ, Larry Don’Ꭾ ᏌᏭ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏍᏊ
segments.transliteration: (uyetsi,sgv) uyo’dv tsinogadvnv nigada,’dve tla yo’anv,ta, uyo nogadvnv y’know ulihelisdi, gehv doyu, na nigohilv ‘ohu,sdi, ogigisdi, tsigehv y’know? … nigohilv’e gadu datlahv … duya’le yigi, nuna,’nv, … nigv’wu otsadvnelidohv dotsanelohvsgv … nigada, nav aninela, anitsutsa, Larry Don’he sawu tsigehv squu
segments.translation: [Laughs] We were poor, but we didn’t know that we were poor. But y’know, we were thankful, we always had something to eat. There was always bread there, also beans and potatoes. We were just playing all the time. All of us. Our neighbors, too. One of them was Larry Don.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏍᎩᎾᎾ “ᎤᏏᏅᏓ,” ᏥᏕᏣᏙᎠ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎬᏗ, ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗᏍᎪ, ᎦᏓ,Ꭷ, ᏍᎩᎾ? ᎩᎶ’Ꭸ…?
segments.transliteration: sginana “usinvda,” tsidetsadoa tsalagi, gvdi, gohu,sdisgo, gada,ka, sgina? gilo’ge…?
segments.translation: What about your name “Usinvd(a)”? Does it mean something? Or is it someone’s…?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᏊ … ᎾᎮᎾ, ᏗᏥ’ᎶᏱ, ᎮᎾ, Ꮎ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏏᏂ, ᏥᏚᏙᎥ ᎠᏴ’Ꮕ, ᎤᏏᏅᏓ, ᎠᏣᎳᎩ, ᏧᎾ,ᏛᎯᏍᏗ, ᏣᏁᎲ ᎤᎾ Bell-Ꭲ ᏗᏢ, Ꮭ ᏍᏊ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᏫᏚᎾ,ᏙᎥ ᏃᏭ, ᏲᏁᎦ, ᎬᏗ, ᏃᏭ ᏥᎩ, ᏍᎩ ᏚᎾ,ᏙᎥ ᏥᎨᎲ “ᎠᏏᏂ,” “ᎤᏏᏅᏓ”Ꮕ, … ᎾᏅ ᏓᏩᏙᎥ ᏍᏊ ᎠᏂᎦᏴᎳ, Bell-Ꭲ ᏗᏢ, “Roy” ᎮᎾ, ‘ᎥᏬᏎᎰ Roy Collins ᏂᎦᏓ’Ꮕ, Collin ᎠᏎ Ꮵ,ᏈᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ᏓᏩᏙᎠ, (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ) “Collin” ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏮᏃᏎᎰ ᎠᏂᏲᏟ, ᎠᏂ--ᎠᏂᎨᏳᏣ, ᏂᎦᏓ, “Collin” ᏴᏬᏌ, ᏭᏅᎦ,Ꮫ’Ꮕ, “Roy” ᏍᎩᎾ ᏂᎦᏓ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ Ꮎ ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎡᏙᎯ, ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏚᏂᎧᎭ, ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, “Uncle Roy”’Ꭱ ‘ᎥᏬᏎᎰ
segments.transliteration: squu … nahena, ditsi’loyi, hena, na tsosdadanvtli, hena, asini, tsidudov ayv’nv, usinvda, atsalagi, tsuna,dvhisdi, tsanehv una Bell-i ditlv, tla squu yawanv,ta, widuna,dov nowu, yonega, gvdi, nowu tsigi, sgi duna,dov tsigehv “asini,” “usinvda”nv, … nanv dawadov squu anigayvla, Bell-i ditlv, “Roy” hena, ‘vwoseho Roy Collins nigada’nv, Collin ase tsi,quisdi, hena, dawadoa, (uyetsi,sgv) “Collin” hena, awvnoseho aniyotli, ani--anigeyutsa, nigada, “Collin” yvwosa, wunvga,dv’nv, “Roy” sgina nigada, adanelv na tsosdadanvtli, edohi, nigada, dunikaha, diniyotli, “Uncle Roy”’e ‘vwoseho
segments.translation: I’m a twin. My brother’s name was Asin(i) and my name is Usinvd(a). There were old Cherokee men at Bell and I don’t know their English names, but their names were Asin(i) and Usinvd(a). And also, my name at Bell, the older people, they called me “Roy. – Roy College.” Yeah, Roy Collins. I have a lot of names. [laughs] The girls would call me “Collin.” The rest of them call me “Roy.” And my brother’s kids call me “Uncle Roy.”

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Why is that?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ Ꮎ Ꭴ--ᏍᏊ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ -- ᏣᏩᏕᏅ ᎮᎾ, Ꮭ ᏯᎩ,ᏍᏘᎨ … ᏍᎩᎾ Roy Collins ᏧᏙᎢᏓ, ᏤᎲ ᎠᏨᏏᏰᎢᏙᎲ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ ᎤᏛᎯᏍᏗ, ᏍᏊ ᏄᏍᏘᎬᎾ, ᎨᎲ … “ᏙᏳ’Ꭱ Roy Collins ᏳᏪᎵᏍᏗ,!” ᏃᏭ, ᎤᎾᏛᏅ … ᎠᏂᏴᏫ Ᏹ’Ꭵ’ᎢᎪᎠ, ᎤᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎠᏴ, ᏣᏩᏕᏅ
segments.transliteration: sgi’dv na u--squu digaduhv -- tsawadenv hena, tla yagi,stige … sgina Roy Collins tsudoida, tsehv atsvsiyeidohv digaduhv udvhisdi, squu nustigvna, gehv … “doyu’e Roy Collins yuwelisdi,!” nowu, unadvnv … aniyvwi yi’v’igoa, usdi tsigehv ayv, tsawadenv
segments.translation: When I was born, I didn’t have hair. That Roy Collins was around then, he was walking around town, he was an old man. He didn’t have hair either. “Boy, he looks just like Roy Collins!” That’s what people said when they saw me. I was a small baby.
[Laughter]

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: So that’s where they got it from?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏭ’Ꭱ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ, ᏙᎲ? ᏍᎩᏭ ᏃᏭ, ᏭᎴᏅᎲ
segments.transliteration: sgiwu’e nunasdi anitsalagi, dohv? sgiwu nowu, wulenvhv
segments.translation: That’s how the Cherokee are, ain’t it? And that’s where it all started.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: How many children were in the family?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Six. Three girls and three boys.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do all of you speak Cherokee?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎥᎥ yeah—huh uh! Ꮎ Ꭴ-ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ, ᏦᏍᏓᏓᏅᏟ, ᎤᏩᏌ, ᏱᎪᎵ,Ꭶ,’Ꭱ ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏱᎪᎵ,Ꭶ, ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꮭ Ᏹ--ᏱᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: vv yeah—huh uh! na u-usdikani, tsosdadanvtli, uwasa, yigoli,ga,’e nigada, yigoli,ga, ‘ahena, tla yi--yigawonisgo
segments.translation: Yeah. Uh uh! All except my youngest brother. He can understand it, he’ll understand everything, but he doesn’t speak it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do you all still get together, your family?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮭ ᏙᏳ, ᏙᎯᏳ, Ꮭ … ‘Ꮫ Mama ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ᏃᏭ, Ꮭ’Ꮓ ᎰᏩ… ᎣᏣᏁᎵ,ᏗᎰ ᏄᏓᎵᎭ ᎮᎾ, ‘Ꮲ Ꮭ’Ᏺ ᏙᏳ,
segments.transliteration: tla doyu, dohiyu, tla … ‘dv Mama tsuyohusv nowu, tla’no howa… otsaneli,diho nudaliha hena, ‘tlv tla’yo doyu,
segments.translation: Not really. Not really since Mama died. We try every now and again, but not really.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What about when you all see each other? Do you all talk Cherokee [to each other]?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, Ꮟ’Ꮫ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎬᏗ, yeah. ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, Ꮎ ᏧᎾ,ᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᏗ’Ꭱ ᏦᎨᏲᏅ ᏲᏁᎦ, … ᎣᏥᎷᎬ ᎤᎾ’Ꭱ ᏧᎾ,ᏕᎶ,ᏆᎥ Ꮎ … “teacher’s aids” ᏥᏓᏃᏎᎰ Ꭳ’ᎥᏌ ᎣᏥᏅ Ꮎ--ᏙᏳ, ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎩ, ᎨᎲ translate ᎾᏅᏁᎲ … Ꮎ ᏲᏁᎦ, ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᏗᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ,
segments.transliteration: Yeah, si’dv tsalagi, gvdi, yeah. sgi hena, na tsuna,delo,quasdi’e tsogeyonv yonega, … otsilugv una’e tsuna,delo,quav na … “teacher’s aids” tsidanoseho o’vsa otsinv na--doyu, tsalagi, aniwonisgi, gehv translate nanvnehv … na yonega, gawonisgv dideyohvsgi,
segments.translation: Yeah, we still do. The school taught us English. When we got to school, those “teacher aides” they call them. We were sitting there and the ones that speak Cherokee were translating to us while the white teacher was speaking English.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They didn’t get onto you for speaking Cherokee?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Huh uh. Ꮭ’Ᏺ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏱᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ … ᎩᎶ ᎣᎩᏍᎦᏍᏓᏁᎲ
segments.transliteration: Huh uh. tla’yo tla ilvhiyu yiganvdadisgo … gilo ogisgasdanehv
segments.translation: Uh uh. No, they didn’t. I don’t ever remember somebody getting onto us.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꮎ’ᏅᎲ ᏥᏣᎴᏅᎲ ᏕᎭᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᎬ … ᎦᏳ,ᎵᏍᎪ, ᏲᏁᎦ, ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎨ ᎩᎳ,’Ꭸ ᏣᏕᎶ,ᏆᎡ?
segments.transliteration: na’nvhv tsitsalenvhv dehadelo,quasgv … gayu,lisgo, yonega, hiwonisge gila,’ge tsadelo,quae?
segments.translation: How about when you first started school, were you already speaking English? Or did you just learn it then?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: I just learned it there at school.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: How about you? How many kids do you have?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Two boys.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do they speak Cherokee?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏌᏭ’Ꮎ ᎣᏏ ᎦᏬᏂᏍᎪ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ, ᎠᎢ’Ꭾ Ꮭ’Ᏺ … ᏙᏳ,’Ꭱ ᎤᏩᏌ, … ᎾᎮᎾ, Ꮭ ᏙᏳ, ᎠᏴ, ᏱᏥᏰᏲᏅ ᎤᏩᏌ, ᎮᎾ, Ꭴ-ᎤᏓᏰ-ᎤᏓᏕᏲᏅ ᏍᏊ Ꮎ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎨᎲ--Ᏹ-ᏯᎪᎵᏯ ᏍᏊ ᎠᎢ ᎮᎾ, Ꮎ’Ꭱ ᏐᎢ,’Ᏺ Ꮭ
segments.transliteration: sawu’na osi gawonisgo usdikani, ai’he tla’yo … doyu,’e uwasa, … nahena, tla doyu, ayv, yitsiyeyonv uwasa, hena, u-udaye-udadeyonv squu na tsalagi, gehv--yi-yagoliya squu ai hena, na’e soi,’yo tla
segments.translation: One speaks alright. The youngest. I didn’t really--He learned--I didn’t really teach him. He taught himself. He can read it, too. But the other one can’t.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏂᎦᏓ,’Ꮫ ᎯᎢ, Ꮳ-ᏣᎳᎩ, ᏥᏗᏬᏂᏍᎩ, ᏥᏗᏯ ᎮᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ᎩᎶ ᏱᎨᏲᏅ ᏙᎲ? Ꭲ-Ꭲ-Ꭲ-ᎢᎾ’Ꮽ ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏴ, ᏗᎨᎩᎦᏴᎵᎨ--
segments.transliteration: nigada,’dv hii, tsa-tsalagi, tsidiwonisgi, tsidiya hesdi, hena, gilo yigeyonv dohv? i-i-i-ina’wu hena, ayv, digegigayvlige--
segments.translation: All of us in here are speakers, but we weren’t taught. Our parents--

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: --they were just speaking it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: --they were just speaking it.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎢᎦ,ᏛᏓᏍᏛ’Ꮽ, ᏍᏊ ᎮᎾ, ᎠᏴ, ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ ᏥᏲᏎᎲ Ꮎ Mitch ᎣᏍᏗᏯᎥ’Ꮽ, ᎩᎳ’Ꮽ, … ᎠᏮᎨᏍᎪ ᎮᎾ, Ꮭ ᎰᏩ ᏱᏥᏬ-ᏱᏥᏬᏂᏍᎪ ᏣᎳᎩ, ‘ᏓᏁᎸ
segments.transliteration: iga,dvdasdv’wu, squu hena, ayv, hena, squu tsiyosehv na Mitch osdiyav’wu, gila’wu, … awvgesgo hena, tla howa yitsiwo-yitsiwonisgo tsalagi, ‘danelv
segments.translation: Yeah, and we were just listening. I was telling Mitch a little while ago, in here, I forget ‘cause I don’t use it enough at the house.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Do you really want to speak Cherokee?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Oh yeah, ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎪ ᎮᎾ, ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ ‘ᎡᎵ ᎠᎩ,ᏍᏕᎵᎰ ᎦᏓᏅᏖᏍᎬ,’Ꮽ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎾᏮᎨᏫ,ᏍᎬᎾ, ᎨᎲ … ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎮᎾ, ᏴᏓᏅ,Ꮫ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎨᎵᎰ ᎠᏴ, … ᏏᎾ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏲᏁᎦ’Ꮽ ᎨᎲ ᎠᏓᏅ,ᏖᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: Oh yeah, gadanvtesgo hena, sgi’dv ‘eli agi,sdeliho gadanvtesgv,’wu tsalagi, nawvgewi,sgvna, gehv … osda, hena, yvdanv,dv tsalagi, geliho ayv, … sina, nigohilv yonega’wu gehv adanv,tesgv
segments.translation: Oh yeah, I think in Cherokee. I think that’s what helps me, thinking. I don’t forget. If you think about the Cherokee language all the time, it’s good. Better than thinking about English all the time.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: I understand what you’re saying.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏙᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ … ᏱᏩᎩᎷᏣ,’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏲᏁᎦ, ᏃᏭ, … ᏳᏓᎭ ᏍᎩ ᎨᎵ Ꮥ--ᏓᏤᏝ, ᏱᏥᏬᏂᎯ, ᏲᏁᎦ, ᏏᎾ, ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎨᎲ ᏃᏭ,
segments.transliteration: ‘ahena, dolvwi,sdanehv … yiwagilutsa,’le yigi, adanelv nigada, yonega, nowu, … yudaha sgi geli de--datsetla, yitsiwonihi, yonega, sina, tsalagi, gehv nowu,
segments.translation: When you work, or when you get home, it’s all English. Sometimes I think I can speak English better than I can Cherokee, now.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Y’know?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did you graduate at Bell?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yes, I graduated there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: When you graduated, where did you go?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Well, Stilwell’Ꮫ ᏂᎪᎯ,Ꮈ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎠᎬᏱ ᏗᏢ ᎠᏭ, ᎦᎶᏍᎬ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᎣᎦᏍᏛᎢᏰᎥ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᏍᏆᏞᏍᏗ’Ꮽ, ᏗᏁᎶ,Ꮧ ᎠᏂᏲᏁᎦ, ᏓᎾ,ᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᎬ ᎠᏆ,ᏛᎦᏅ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, Cave Springs ᏗᏢ, … ᏬᎩᎷᏨ ᎾᎮᎾ ᎤᏔᏂᏓ, ᏦᏍᏓᏓᎸ ᎦᏳ,Ꮃ, ᎤᎴᏅᏓ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, Mama – Bell-Ꭲ Ꮶ’ᎠᏂᎩᏒ ᏑᎾᎴ bus Dahlonegah School’Ᏼ ᏬᎩ,ᏘᏂᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ ᏬᏥᏂᏱᏍᎬ Ꮎ … bus Ꮼ’ᎠᏣᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ … Oh, ‘Ꮧ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ,’Ᏼ about 6 years ᏍᎩ ᏄᏛᏁᎸ Mama. … ᎤᎾ Ꮼ’ᎢᏂᏱᏍᎬ ᏒᎯᏰ ᏱᎩ, … ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꮎ Ᏺ--Ꮎ--ᏲᎦᎳᏍᎦᎵᏍᎬ, after school, Ꭳ’ᎢᎾᎵ’Ꮽ, ᏫᏥᏍᏓᏩᏕᏍᎬ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏒᎯᏰ ᏱᎩ, Ꮜ-Ꮜ-ᏌᏭ ᏳᏩᎦ,Ꮣ, Ᏻ[ᏓᎵ,] Mama Ꭳ’ᎩᏂᏱᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ … ᏲᎩᏍᏆᏓ, ᏙᏣᏁᎶᎲᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: Well, Stilwell’dv nigohi,lv adanelv agvyi ditlv awu, galosgv ‘ahena, ogasdviyev tsalagi, squatlesdi’wu, dinelo,di aniyonega, dana,delo,quasgv aqua,dvganv … nowu’nv, Cave Springs ditlv, … wogilutsv nahena utanida, tsosdadalv gayu,la, ulenvda, tsi’ehv nowu’nv, Mama – Bell-i tso’anigisv sunale bus Dahlonegah School’yv wogi,tinisgv una wotsiniyisgv na … bus wo’atsasgv una … Oh, ‘di yawanv,ta,’yv about 6 years sgi nudvnelv Mama. … una wo’iniyisgv svhiye yigi, … ‘ahena, na yo--na--yogalasgalisgv, after school, o’inali’wu, witsisdawadesgv … nowu’nv, svhiye yigi, sa-sa-sawu yuwaga,da, yu[dali,] Mama o’giniyisgv una … yogisquada, dotsanelohvsgv
segments.translation: Well, there was a Stilwell bus that always went by the house. I had heard that the Cherokee/Native boys weren’t getting to play ball with the White school. That’s when we got to Cave Springs. My older sister had already started there. Then Mama, when we left the house in Bell, she would take us all the way to Dahlonegah School. That’s where we would catch the bus, we’d get on to ride. Oh, I don’t know, Mama did that for about six years. And that’s where she picked us up in the evening. When we would play ball after school, I would just go home with my friend. And then in the evening, sometimes Mama would pick us up there. When we would get done playing.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: Football-ᎢᏍᎪ, ᏄᏅᏁ Cave Springs ᎾᎯᏳ ᏣᎴᏅᏓ, ᏂᎯ?
segments.transliteration: Football-isgo, nunvne Cave Springs nahiyu tsalenvda, nihi?
segments.translation: Did they have football at Cave Springs when you started?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏅᏅ ᏔᎵᏁ--senior year Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ twelfth--ᏔᎵᏁ ᏥᏯᎥ--
segments.transliteration: sginvnv taline--senior year tsi’ehv twelfth--taline tsiyav--
segments.translation: Well, that, I was in my senior year. That’s when they started the first team.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: That was when they started?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: That was when. We were the first ones they started with! But not…Boy!

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: [Laughs] Were you all pretty good?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Well, ᏌᏭ Ꭳ’ᎠᏓᏠᏒ’Ꮽ! (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ) ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꮭ’ᎮᎾ, ᏲᏥᎦ,ᏔᎲ Ꮶ’ᎠᏁᎶ,Ꮧ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ,
segments.transliteration: Well, sawu o’adatlosv’wu! (uyetsi,sgv) ‘ahena, tla’hena, yotsiga,tahv tso’anelo,di ‘ahena,
segments.translation: Well, we won one game! [Laughs] We didn’t really know how to play.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Who were the coaches?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Terry Mays’Ꮕ ᎾᏅ Joe, Joe… Eubanks. Boy, Ꮎ’Ꭱ Terry’Ꮫ … ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎨᎲ’Ᏺ
segments.transliteration: Terry Mays’nv nanv Joe, Joe… Eubanks. Boy, na’e Terry’dv … osda, gehv’yo
segments.translation: That Terry Mays and Joe … Eubanks. Boy, that Terry was good.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎣᏍᏓ,’Ꭷ ᏙᏳ, ᏥᏄᎾᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ, ᏧᏕᏘᏴᏓ, ᏙᎲ?
segments.transliteration: osda,’ka doyu, tsinunali,stanv ilvsgi, tsudetiyvda, dohv?
segments.translation: Yeah, but they got to be a good team.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Is that where you graduated, Cave Springs?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah. Yeah, Terry Mays’Ꮫ … ᏲᎩᏍᏆᏓ, ᏙᏣᏁᎶᎲᏍᎬ Bell-ᎢᏴ ᏥᏩᎩᎧᎲᏍᎬ ᏄᏓᎵᎭ
segments.transliteration: Yeah. Yeah, Terry Mays’dv … yogisquada, dotsanelohvsgv Bell-iyv tsiwagikahvsgv nudaliha
segments.translation: Yeah. Sometimes when we got through playing ball, that Terry Mays would drive me home. All the way to Bell.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: He spoke good Cherokee then, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, ᏍᏊ’Ꮫ ᎤᏓᏅ,Ꮨ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎰ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ ᎤᏁᎫᏥᏓ, ᏍᏊ ᎡᏧᎳ, … ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎿᏛᏁᎲᎾ, ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ’Ꭱ paddle ᎬᏗ, Ꮩ’ᎢᎸᏂᎸ ᏍᏊ ᏥᎨᎲ (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ)
segments.transliteration: Yeah. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, squu’dv udanv,ti, tsi’eho ‘ahena, squu hena, squu unegutsida, squu etsula, … osda, hnadvnehvna, yigi, na’e paddle gvdi, do’ilvnilv squu tsigehv (uyetsi,sgv)
segments.translation: Yeah. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, he was also kind, but he could also be mean. When you weren’t doing good or acting right, he would hit us with a paddle. [laughs]

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎤᎾ’Ꭷ ᎾᎯᏳ … ᎠᏴ, ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ--ᎠᏴ, ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ ᎤᎾᎾ--ᎥᎾ ᎠᏩᏛᏒ … Bunch-Ꭲ ᎪᎢ ᏍᏊ ᎪᎢ ᎠᏩᎴᏅᏓ, ᏣᏗ ᎤᏠᏱ … ᏍᏊ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩᎭ ᎣᏥᏣᎳᎩᎭ ᏗᎾ,ᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ’Ꮕ, ᏍᏊ ᏗᎾ,ᏕᏲᎲᏍᎩ, ᏗᏂᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᏍᏊ ᎠᏂᏣᎳᎩ, … ᏩᎾᎠ’Ꮫ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏣᏅ,Ꮤ, Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏃᏭᎴ ᏍᏊ ᏩᎾ ᏍᏊ … Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᎩᎶ ᏱᎦᏅᏓᏗ ᎩᎶ ᎠᎦᏅᏍᏓᏕᎲ ᏲᏁᎦ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: una’ka nahiyu … ayv, hena, squu--ayv, hena, squu unana--vna awadvsv … Bunch-i goi squu goi awalenvda, tsadi utloyi … squu anitsalagiha otsitsalagiha dina,deyohvsgi’nv, squu dina,deyohvsgi, dinisdelisgi, squu anitsalagi, … wanaa’dv tsigehv tsanv,ta, tla gohu,sdi, nowule squu wana squu … tla ilvhiyu gilo yiganvdadi gilo aganvsdadehv yonega gawonihisdi
segments.translation: Also, back then, … That’s where I grew up, too. Greasy-Bunch. When I started at Greasy, just like you said, it was the same, we were all Cherokee and the teachers and their aides were Cherokee. It was easy, y’know, nothing--it was easy [with the Cherokee language]. I don’t remember anyone ever getting onto anyone else for speaking English.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᎠᏴ,’ᏛᎲ Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ--Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ Ꭹ--ᎩᎶ ᏍᎩ Ꮎ’ᎢᏪᏎᎸ ᏱᎨᎮ ᏍᏊ
segments.transliteration: Yeah, ayv,’dvhv tla ilvhiyu--tla ilvhiyu gi--gilo sgi na’iweselv yigehe squu
segments.translation: Yeah, me too. Nobody ever said that to me, either.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Were you already speaking English when you started school?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: You mean grade school?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yes.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Huh uh, huh uh, ᎤᎾ’Ꮫ Ꮵ-- ᏧᎾ,ᏕᎶᏆᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ,
segments.transliteration: Huh uh, huh uh, una’dv tsi-- tsuna,deloquasdi, hena,
segments.translation: Uh uh, uh uh, it wasn’t until I started school.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You learned it there?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎠᏩᏕᎶ,ᏆᎥ yeah. … ᎢᎸᏍᎩ, ᏓᎩᎧᎲ ᏍᏊ y’know, ‘ᎣᎨᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏂᏣᏅ,ᏛᎾ, ᏲᏁᎦ, ᏱᎩ, y’know, ᎡᏤᏲᎲᏍᎪ ᎮᎾ, … Ꮎ Maybeline Still … Zelma Cochran ᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ Ꮎ teacher aides ᎨᎲ ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎠᏂᏬᏂᏍᎪ ᎮᎾ, ᎦᏳ,Ꮃ, ᎠᏂᎦ,ᏔᎲ ᏲᏁᎦ, y’know.
segments.transliteration: awadelo,quav yeah. … ilvsgi, dagikahv squu y’know, ‘ogeyohvsgv nitsanv,dvna, yonega, yigi, y’know, etseyohvsgo hena, … na Maybeline Still … Zelma Cochran ganvdadisgo na teacher aides gehv tsalagi, aniwonisgo hena, gayu,la, aniga,tahv yonega, y’know.
segments.translation: Yeah, I learned it there. I had a few of them teaching me. If you didn’t know English, they were teaching you. There was Maybeline Still and Zelma Cochran, I remember it. They were Cherokee-speaking teacher aides and they already knew English.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: When you finished at [Cave Springs,] what’d you do?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮎ ᏔᎵᏁ? Cave Springs ᏓᎩ,ᏍᏆᏛ? Oh, ᏍᎩᏭ’Ꮫ Greenleaf’Ꮫ ᏞᎦ, ᏥᏩᏩᎴᏅᎲ ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᎤᎾ’Ꮫ Greenleaf ᏥᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ … Paul Holloway ᏧᏙᎢᏓ Ꮎ concrete—
segments.transliteration: na taline? Cave Springs dagi,squadv? Oh, sgiwu’dv Greenleaf’dv tlega, tsiwawalenvhv dagilvwi,sdanehv … nowu’nv, una’dv Greenleaf tsidagilvwi,sdanehv … Paul Holloway tsudoida na concrete—
segments.translation: The second one? When I graduated Cave Springs? I started working at Greenleaf for a little while. When I was working at Greenleaf, there was a man named Paul Holloway. Concrete--

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Construction, M and M.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: --construction. ᎾᏛᏁᎲ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ … ᎾᎾ ᏄᏓᎴ ᎦᏚᎲ ᎣᎩᏒᏢ y’know ᏙᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᎨᎲ--I wasn’t--Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᎠᏕᎳ, ᏱᎪᏢᏍᎨ ᎦᏗᏔᏍᎬ (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ)
segments.transliteration: --construction. nadvnehv ‘ahena, nigohilv … nana nudale gaduhv ogisvtlv y’know dogilvwi,sdanehv tla gohu,sdi, gehv--I wasn’t--tla gohu,sdi, adela, yigotlvsge gaditasgv (uyetsi,sgv)
segments.translation: He was doing concrete and construction. But we were always staying in different towns while we worked. But I wasn’t making any money ‘cause I was drinking all the time. [laughs]

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: That’s what he used to do, Paul.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᏥᎨᎳᏓᎵᏙᎲ ᎥᎥ, Paul, ᏍᏊ boy, ᏍᏊ ᎥᎥ ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ ᏄᏛᎾ ᏥᎨᎲ … ᏩᎩ,ᏍᏆᎵ,Ꮢ Ꮎ jackhammer ᎬᏗ, ᎤᏔᎾ, ᏥᎾᏌᏛ ᏍᎩᏃ Ꮭ-Ꮭ ᏯᎩᎷᏨ ᏃᏭ,’Ꮓ Ꮧ-- ᎠᏴ… Ꮎ Cherokee Nation programs ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ eighty—‘87’Ꮫ ᎨᎵ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏃᏭ, ᏓᎩ--Ꮎ Ꮩ’ᎢᎾ,--ᎠᎩ,ᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ, Ꮩ’ᎢᎾ,--
segments.transliteration: Yeah, tsigeladalidohv vv, Paul, squu boy, squu vv sgi’dv nudvna tsigehv … wagi,squali,sv na jackhammer gvdi, utana, tsinasadv sgino tla-tla yagilutsv nowu,’no di-- ayv… na Cherokee Nation programs dagilvwi,sdanehv … nowu’nv eighty—‘87’dv geli tsigehv nowu, dagi--na do’ina,--agi,sdayvhvsgi, do’ina,--
segments.translation: Yeah, I would be with him. Me and Paul. Using a jackhammer, I broke my big toe. So I didn’t go back, I started working with Cherokee Nation programs. Then about eighty-- ’87 that’s when--me and my wife, we--

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You two got married.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮥ-Ꮩ-ᏙᏍᏓᏨᏍᏔᏅ ᎥᎥ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, let’s see Ꮭ ᏍᏊ ᏙᏳ, ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏱᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎾᏞᎦ, Ꮎ Cherokee Nation ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, Ꮎ Zion coach, Charles Binham ᎤᏚᎵᎲ ᏩᎩᎷᎯᏍᏗ ᏗᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ … ᏍᎩᎾ ᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎩ, ᎨᎲ … ᎾᎾ 14 years ᎠᏪᏙᎸ Zion ᏥᏥᏍᏕᎵᏍᎬ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, principal ᏥᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ ᏃᏭ office-Ꭲ’Ꮽ ᏩᏯᎥ ᎠᏮᏌ, ᎦᏛᏁᎲ
segments.transliteration: de-do-dosdatsvstanv vv … nowu’nv, let’s see tla squu doyu, osda, yiganvdadisgo natlega, na Cherokee Nation dagilvwi,sdanehv nowu’nv, na Zion coach, Charles Binham udulihv wagiluhisdi digilvwi,sdane,di … sgina tsisdelisgi, gehv … nana 14 years awedolv Zion tsitsisdelisgv … nowu’nv, principal tsinuli,stanv nowu office-i’wu wayav awvsa, gadvnehv
segments.translation: --we got married, yeah. Let’s see, I don’t remember it well, but that’s about when I started working for Cherokee Nation. Then that coach from Zion, Charles [Binham?]. He wanted me to come to work helping him. I went to help Zion for 14 years. Then when he became the principal, he went into the office and I was doing it all by myself.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Was it basketball?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Basketball, ᏂᎦᏓ, Ꮎ football-Ꭲ’Ꮕ, softball ᏂᎦᏓ, … Ꭳ’ᎢᏅᏌ, ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ … ᏍᎩᎾ, ᏍᏊ Ꮟ-Ꮟ’Ꮫ Ꮎ basketball ‘ᎸᏢ ᏱᏬ’ᎡᏙᎳ, ᏃᏭ’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, ᏍᏊ Zion’Ꭲ ᏙᏱ … ᏲᎩᏍᏆᏓ, ᏙᏣᏁᎶᎲᏍᎬ bus route ᏥᏃ’ᎥᏅ ᎤᏒ … ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, ᏫᏥᎧᎲᏍᎬ ᏧᏁᏅᎲ … Ꮭ’Ꮓ ᏍᎩ ᏱᏅᎾ,ᏛᎦ,
segments.transliteration: Basketball, nigada, na football-i’nv, softball nigada, … o’invsa, hena, squu … sgina, squu si-si’dv na basketball ‘lvtlv yiwo’edola, nowu’le yigi, squu Zion’i doyi … yogisquada, dotsanelohvsgv bus route tsino’vnv usv … diniyotli, witsikahvsgv tsunenvhv … tla’no sgi yinvna,dvga,
segments.translation: It was basketball, football, softball, all of it. The basketball team, if we went somewhere to play, or outside at Zion. When we got through playing a game, we had a bus route taking all of the kids home, at night. They can’t do that now.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Uh uh, uh uh.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ ᏃᏭ’ᏛᏃ … 14 years ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏃᏭ Ozark Electric ᏗᏢ, ᏃᏭ, … Charles Krozer ᏧᏙᎢᏓ, ᎤᎾ ᏣᏯᎥ ᏧᎧᏏ,Ꮯ, ᏥᏛ(Ꭹ)ᏓᏁᎸ Ꮧ’ᎢᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ ᎢᎾ “Huh uh,” ᏥᏲᏎᎸ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ, Ꭰ’ᎥᏱ … about a week later, ᏚᏛᏅ … “ᎥᎥ” ᏥᏲᎮᎸ
segments.transliteration: nowu’nv nowu’dvno … 14 years dagilvwi,sdanehv nowu Ozark Electric ditlv, nowu, … Charles Krozer tsudoida, una tsayav tsukasi,tli, tsidv(gi)danelv di’ilvwi,sdane,di ina “Huh uh,” tsiyoselv ilvsgi, a’vyi … about a week later, dudvnv … “vv” tsiyohelv
segments.translation: I worked there for 14 years, then after that I went to Ozark Electric. Charles Krozer was his name, the boss. He would call me to come to work, “Uh uh,” I told him a few times. About a week later, he called. “Yeah,” I told him.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: He finally broke you?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎤᎾ’Ꮽ, ᏃᏭ, … ᏣᏩᎴᏅᎲ ᎤᎾ … ᏙᏳ ᎠᏩᎵᎮᎵᏨ “ᎥᎥ” ᏣᏩᏛᏅ ᎮᎾ, Ꮝ--ᏙᎯᏳ ᏓᏤᏢ ᎠᎾ,ᏈᏱᏍᎬ … Boy, ᎾᎮᎾ, ᏧᎾ,ᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᏗᎢ Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏯᎾ,ᏈᏱᏍᎨ ᏙᎯᏳ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏯᎩ,ᏍᏆᏓ, [ᏗᏓᏘᏂᏙᎲ] bus route’Ꭱ ᏍᏊ ᏥᎾᏮᏅ ᎤᎾ Zion-Ꭲ ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ -- ᏯᎩ,ᏍᏆᏓ, bus route ᏃᏭ, ᎦᏄᎳ Ꮵ’ᎠᎵᏍᎬ ᏗᎦᏚᎲ
segments.transliteration: una’wu, nowu, … tsawalenvhv una … doyu awalihelitsv “vv” tsawadvnv hena, s--dohiyu datsetlv ana,quiyisgv … Boy, nahena, tsuna,delo,quasdii tla gohu,sdi, yana,quiyisge dohiyu … nowu’nv, yagi,squada, [didatinidohv] bus route’e squu tsinawvnv una Zion-i dagilvwi,sdanehv -- yagi,squada, bus route nowu, ganula tsi’alisgv digaduhv
segments.translation: Then when I started working there, I was really glad I said “yeah.” Because they were paying better there. They weren’t paying anything at the school, really. When I got done [coaching], they had me on a bus route at Zion, when I worked there. When I got through with that, then I went to cut grass in town.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Gah!

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Gah!

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏯᎩᎷᏣ, ᎠᏓᏁᎸ … ᎤᏒ’Ᏼ ᎩᎳ, ᏥᏥᎦᎵ,ᏍᎬ ᎦᏄᎳ … ᏙᏱ,’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ ᎧᏁᏍᎦ, ᎠᏮᏌ, Ꮳ’ᎢᎲ Ꮎ truck ᎧᏁᏍᎦ, ᏥᎾ,ᏏᏁᏍᎬ, ᏱᏄ,-- … ᏙᏳ, ᏍᎩ’ᏭᏛ … ᏍᎩ’ᏭᏛ … ᎤᏃᏍᏛ … ᏱᏄᏍᏛ, -- to make a dollar. Ꮒ,ᎦᏛᏁᎲ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏃᏭ, Ꮎ Ozarks call ᏥᏄᏅᏁᎸ … ᏥᏩ(Ꭹ)ᏑᎵ,ᎪᏨ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏍᎩᎾᎾ ᏓᏤᏢ ᎠᎾ,Ꮘ--Ꮟ Ꭳ-ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎠᎾ,ᏈᏱᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: yagilutsa, adanelv … usv’yv gila, tsitsigali,sgv ganula … doyi,’le yigi, na kanesga, awvsa, tsa’ihv na truck kanesga, tsina,sinesgv, yinu,-- … doyu, sgi’wudv … sgi’wudv … unosdv … yinusdv, -- to make a dollar. ni,gadvnehv … nowu’nv, nowu, na Ozarks call tsinunvnelv … tsiwa(gi)suli,gotsv ni’ada, sginana datsetlv ana,qui--si o-osda, ana,quiyisgv una
segments.translation: When I got home, I’d be cutting grass until the nighttime. Or outside, I had my own hay baling truck; I was hauling hay. Whatever there was to make a dollar, I was doing it. When Ozark called me, I quit doing all that, because they were paying better. They still pay good there.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: It really turned out good for you. You made a good choice-.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᏍᎩ’ᏭᎡ ᏭᎵ,ᏍᏛ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, … twenty—25 years Ꮒ’ᎡᏙᎰ ᏃᏭ, ᎤᎾ Ozark [Electric]
segments.transliteration: Yeah, sgi’wue wuli,sdv nowu’nv, … twenty—25 years ni’edoho nowu, una Ozark [Electric]
segments.translation: Yeah, it really did. Now I’ve been working there for 25 years at Ozark [Electric].

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: You still like it?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Eh. [laughs]

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’ᏛᏲ ᏂᎦᎵ,ᏍᏗ ᏙᎲ? ᏍᏊ-- … ᏍᏊ ᎭᏢ’Ꮽ ᏱᎩ, Ꮭ ᎮᎾ, ᎣᏍᏗᎲᎾ, ᏱᎨᎮᏍᏗ, Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏱᎬᎭᏅ,ᏓᏗ
segments.transliteration: sgi’dvyo nigali,sdi dohv? squu-- … squu hatlv’wu yigi, tla hena, osdihvna, yigehesdi, tla gohu,sdi, yigvhanv,dadi
segments.translation: That happens, doesn’t it? No matter where it is. Things start happening that you don’t like.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Huh uh. (…) ‘Ꮫ ᎾᎾ -- Ꮎ call—call list ᏄᏅᏃ every two months. One week, Friday ᏱᏣᎴᏅᎭ, everything over after 3:30’Ꭱ ᏦᏥᏑᎵ,Ꭺ anything over 3:30pm ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏳᎵ,ᏍᏔᎾ, ᎠᏴ, ᎾᎾ Ꭳ’ᎢᎾ,ᎵᏲ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏫᏃ-ᏫᏃᎦᏛᏁ,Ꮧ, ᎨᎰ … ᏍᎩ ᎦᏳ,Ꮃ,’Ꮫ ᏦᏍᎪᎯ,’ᏛᏅ ‘ᎸᏢ overtime hours Ꮣ’ᎢᎭ, this week ᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ ᎾᏮᏛᎿ,
segments.transliteration: Huh uh. (…) ‘dv nana -- na call—call list nunvno every two months. One week, Friday yitsalenvha, everything over after 3:30’e tsotsisuli,go anything over 3:30pm gohu,sdi, yuli,stana, ayv, nana o’ina,liyo osda, wino-winogadvne,di, geho … sgi gayu,la,’dv tsosgohi,’dvnv ‘lvtlv overtime hours da’iha, this week sgi iga nawvdvhna,
segments.translation: Uh uh. They have a call list. Every two months, on a Friday when you start, everything over 3:30pm. 3:30pm is when we quit. If something happens after 3:30pm, then it’s overtime. The guy I work with, we have to fix whatever is wrong. Just this week, I had about 30 hours of overtime.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Sometimes do you have to get up in the middle of the night or early in the morning?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎠᏎ ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ--ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ ᏳᏍᏗ, ᏣᎩᏅᏛ ᏒᎯ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ all night ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎸ … ᏒᎯ, ᎤᏒ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ
segments.transliteration: ase sgi’dv--sgi’dv yusdi, tsaginvdv svhi, tsi’ehv all night dagilvwi,sdanelv … svhi, usv tsi’ehv
segments.translation: That’s why I missed yesterday, because I worked all night. The night before last.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᏍᎪ ‘ᎸᏢ’Ᏼ ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ, … ᎠᏏᎳ,Ꮩ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏫᏅᏁᎰ?
segments.transliteration: nasgo ‘lvtlv’yv yigi, na anagalisgi, … asila,do sgina osda, winvneho?
segments.translation: Do you have to fix the electric wires sometimes?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah, when it breaks, we fix it.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏭᏟ ᎮᎾ’Ꮓ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, Ꮎ ᏳᏃᎸᎾ, ᏱᎩ, ᏍᏓᏱ’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, ᏳᏩᏂᎳ, ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ‘Ꮲ ᎠᏲᎪ ᏙᎲ?
segments.transliteration: wutli hena’no gohu,sdi, na yunolvna, yigi, sdayi’le yigi, yuwanila, gohu,sdi, ‘tlv ayogo dohv?
segments.translation: Sometimes when the wind blows hard or if something hits it hard enough, it breaks somewhere.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏄᎲ ᏣᎦᏍᎬ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ, ᏄᎲ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ … ᎾᎾ ᎤᏯᏅ … Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᏂᎦᏪᏍᏗ, ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎬᏗ, Ꮎ porcelian ᎫᎫ,’Ꮫ Ꮩ’Ꭱ?
segments.transliteration: nuhv tsagasgv ilvsgi, nuhv tsi’ehv … nana uyanv … tla yawanv,ta, nigawesdi, tsalagi, gvdi, na porcelian gugu,’dv do’e?
segments.translation: You know, a few nights ago, it rained there. I don’t know how to say it in Cherokee, but porcelain – Gug(u) isn’t it?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: It sits on top of it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Insulator.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮎ insulator. ᎾᏅ ᎤᏯᏅ ᎤᎾ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ Ꮎ ᎠᏝᎰ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏲᏨ Ꮎ ᎫᎫ, … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏚᏠᏒ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ’Ꮕ, Boy, Ꮵ,ᏈᏗ’Ꮕ, Ꭰ’ᎠᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ ᎮᎾ, … ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏫᏂᏨᏁ,Ꮧ ᎭᏢ,
segments.transliteration: na insulator. nanv uyanv una nowu’nv na atlaho sgina tsuyotsv na gugu, … nowu’nv, dutlosv ni’ada, anagalisgi’nv, Boy, tsi,quidi’nv, a’asgv una hena, … osda, winitsvne,di hatlv,
segments.translation: Insulator. Then it has a wire, that’s where the porcelain – [gug(u)] sits. The electricity went out. It was raining hard there. You had to go fix it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Was it a live wire? When you’re climbing up there?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮳ--Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ’Ꭱ ᏣᎩᎷᏨ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꮎ office-Ꭲ call ᏱᏫ,ᏅᎬᎦ, ᏱᏓᏅ,ᏝᏓ, … ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏱᏚᎾ,ᏝᏓ, ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, … ground ᎾᏅ--Ꮓ-ᏃᏨᏁᎰ … ᎠᎭᏂ, ground … from Ꮎ ᎤᏗᏞᎩ, ᎨᎲ to the Ꮎ ground wire. ᎤᏯᏅ ᏃᏨᏁᎰ *ᎠᎭᏂ’Ꮕ,* ᏗᏢ, … ᏍᎩᎮᎾ,--ᏍᎩᎮᎾ, ᏱᏂ,ᏨᏁᎳ, Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᎤᏲ ᏱᏂ,ᏣᎵ,ᏍᏓᏌ,
segments.transliteration: tsa--tsi’ehv’e tsagilutsv ‘ahena, na office-i call yiwi,nvgvga, yidanv,tlada, … ‘ahena, yiduna,tlada, nowu’nv, … ground nanv--no-notsvneho … ahani, ground … from na uditlegi, gehv to the na ground wire. uyanv notsvneho *ahani’nv,* ditlv, … sgihena,--sgihena, yini,tsvnela, tla gohu,sdi, uyo yini,tsali,sdasa,
segments.translation: It was when I got there. You can call the office and they will shut it off. When they shut it off, then we ground it. From where it’s hot, we put a wire on it to the ground wire. This [gestures] way. When you do that, nothing will happen to you.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎡᎵ’ᎦᏴᏅ ᏣᎦ,ᏙᎰᏒ ᏂᎦᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅᏍᎬ ᎪᎯ, ᏥᎩ, ᏍᎩ ᏱᎪᎯᏓ, ᏕᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ
segments.transliteration: eli’gayvnv tsaga,dohosv nigali,stanvsgv gohi, tsigi, sgi yigohida, detsalvwi,sdanehv
segments.translation: I guess, nowadays, you have really learned a lot from things happening all that time.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎾ -- ᎾᎾ ‘Ꮲ ᏥᏫ,ᏓᏁᏙᎲ ᏥᏩᎾᎵ,ᏍᏕᎵᎲ Ꮎ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ, ᏫᏤᎳ,ᏗᏙᎸ’Ꭸ?
segments.transliteration: nana -- nana ‘tlv tsiwi,danedohv tsiwanali,sdelihv na gohusdi, witsela,didolv’ge?
segments.translation: How about when they go somewhere to help out, have you ever gone?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Uh huh, yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏝᏍᎪ, … “ᏧᏟᏲᎷᏒ”’Ꭱ ᎠᎾᏗᎰ Florida ᏙᎲ Ꮭ’Ꭸ? ᏣᎳᎩ, ᎬᏗ, ᏍᎩ’Ꭷ ᎾᏂᏪᏍᎪ?
segments.transliteration: tlasgo, … “tsutliyolusv”’e anadiho Florida dohv tla’ge? tsalagi, gvdi, sgi’ka naniwesgo?
segments.translation: Don’t they call Florida – “tsutliyolusv?” Or no? In Cherokee, isn’t that what they say?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: I think so.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏧᏟᏲᎷᏒ ᏝᏍᎪ,--ᏝᏍᎪ, ‘Ᏺ ᎤᎾ--ᎤᎾ’Ꭸ ᏫᏤᏙᎰ ᏳᏓᎭ Ꮎ--Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᏱᎦᏪᏍᏗ, ‘hurricane’ ᎠᏣᎳᎩ, ᎬᏗ,--ᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᎾ, ᏫᏤᎳ,ᏙᎸᏍᎪ, ᎨᎮ?
segments.transliteration: tsutliyolusv tlasgo,--tlasgo, ‘yo una--una’ge witsedoho yudaha na--tla yawanv,ta, yigawesdi, ‘hurricane’ atsalagi, gvdi,--sgi yinuli,stana, witsela,dolvsgo, gehe?
segments.translation: Tsutliyolusv. Don’t you all go there when—I don’t know how to say ‘hurricane’ in Cherokee—when a hurricane happens, have you all been a part of that?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮭ’Ᏺ ᎤᎾ ᏗᏢ, Florida … Ꮭ’Ᏺ ᎩᎶ … ᎤᎾ ᏗᏢ, ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Louisiana ᏗᏢ, ᏩᏁᏙᎲ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ, ᎠᏂ--ᏧᏂ,ᏍᏗᎧᏂ, ᎠᏂᏧᏣ,
segments.transliteration: tla’yo una ditlv, Florida … tla’yo gilo … una ditlv, ‘ahena, Louisiana ditlv, wanedohv anitsutsa, ani--tsuni,sdikani, anitsutsa,
segments.translation: No, not there in Florida. Not there, but they go to Louisiana. Those boys, they’re young boys.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Young men.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎠᏂᏫᏂ, ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, “Ꮭ’Ᏺ ᎠᏴ,’Ᏺ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏚᎵ” ‘ᎡᏥᏲᎮᎰ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᎤᎾ ᏗᏢ,’Ᏺ … Ponca City ᏗᏢ, ᏥᏗᏳᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎾ ᏗᏢ, ‘Ᏺ Ꮵ--ᏩᏪᏙᎸ
segments.transliteration: aniwini, ‘ahena, “tla’yo ayv,’yo tla yawaduli” ‘etsiyoheho ‘ahena, una ditlv,’yo … Ponca City ditlv, tsidiyuli,stanv una ditlv, ‘yo tsi--wawedolv
segments.translation: Young men. “I don’t want to,” I tell them. But when it happened in Ponca City, I went.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: You went.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: I don’t go too far to help.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: What about when it freezes?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: That’s right.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Are you ready for it? Do you still have to fix things?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Boy, it’s annoying when that happens.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Did they teach you to do that when you started?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Right where we were working, it was being taught.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You just learned as you went?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮎ’Ꮕ, ᎪᏪᎵ, Ꮩ’ᎢᏅᏁᎰ … 5 years ᎮᎾ, Ꮎ Appre-Apprentice Program ᎠᏃᏎᎰ … ᏍᎩ test ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏓᏅᏁᎲ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏭᎪᏛ’Ꮽ, ᎮᎾ, ᏕᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ … ᏍᏊ Ꮎ … ᏍᏓᎵᏲ ᏤᏲᎲᏍᎬ ᏭᎪᏛ Ꮎ’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ--Ꮎ … ᏙᏣᏅᏍᎨᏍᎬ … Ꮎ Ꮩ’ᎢᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎣᏣᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᎬ Ꮎ Crew Chief ᎤᏃᏎᏗ, … ᎾᎮᎾ, … ᎯᏍ(Ꭹ)’Ꮫ ᎨᎵ ᏥᏃ’ᎢᎥ--ᏃᏥᎥ everyday Ꮩ’ᎢᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, … ᎣᏍᏓ, Ꮒ,ᏙᏨᏁᎲ ᏃᏭᎴ’Ꮕ, ᎠᏤ ᏙᏤᏛᏍᎬ ᏃᏭ’ᎮᎾ, ᏥᎩ, ᏃᏭ, Ꮎ service truck ᎮᎾ, Ꮵ’ᎢᎵᏙᎰ … ᎤᏍ-ᎤᏍᏗ bucket truck.
segments.transliteration: na’nv, goweli, do’invneho … 5 years hena, na Appre-Apprentice Program anoseho … sgi test gohu,sdi, danvnehv ‘ahena, wugodv’wu, hena, detsalvwi,sdanehv … squu na … sdaliyo tseyohvsgv wugodv na’le yigi, na--na … dotsanvsgesgv … na do’ilvwi,sdanehv otsadelo,quasgv na Crew Chief unosedi, … nahena, … his(gi)’dv geli tsino’iv--notsiv everyday do’ilvwi,sdanehv gohu,sdi, … osda, ni,dotsvnehv nowule’nv, atse dotsedvsgv nowu’hena, tsigi, nowu, na service truck hena, tsi’ilidoho … us-usdi bucket truck.
segments.translation: They give us papers. They called it an Apprenticeship Program for five years. They would give you a test, but it was based on how well you worked. Most of it is what your working partner shows you. Also, what we are building, we are learning as we are working. We have to ask the Crew Chief. I think there were five of us working every day. We were fixing things or putting up new poles. Now, I drive the service truck. A little bucket truck.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Have you ever climbed into or up with the bucket?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮟ’Ꮫ ᏄᏓᎭ Ꮟ’Ꮫ ᏃᏣᏛᏁᎰ Ꮥ’ᎠᏍᏓᏰᏍᎪ ᏃᏭ, … Ꮎ ᏍᏊ ᏒᏃᏱ ᏱᎩ, ᏌᎷᏱ ᏱᎩ, … ᏱᏬ’ᎢᏄᎸᎲᏍᎩ, Ꮎ …--
segments.transliteration: si’dv nudaha si’dv notsadvneho de’asdayesgo nowu, … na squu svnoyi yigi, saluyi yigi, … yiwo’inulvhvsgi, na …--
segments.translation: Yeah, that is what we do. I’m just tired now. Even if it’s the middle of the nightand it’s out in the woods. We have to go, but we have trouble…--

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: --bucket.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: --getting the bucket truck up there, but we have to do it.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: That’s your guys’ obligation.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ‘ᎸᏢ ᏱᏧᏲᏣ, ᎭᏢ’Ꮽ, ᏍᏊ ᏥᎩ, Boy, ᏳᏓᎭ Ꮎ ᏍᏊ ‘Ꮲ ᎦᏳ,Ꮃ, ᎤᏲᏍᏛ ᏫᏥᎷᎪ ᏝᏬᏚᎯ’Ꮕ, ᏙᎲ? Ꮎ ᏯᎦᏍᎦ, ᎢᎦ Ꮎ Ꮻ-ᏫᎦᎶᎯᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: ‘lvtlv yitsuyotsa, hatlv’wu, squu tsigi, Boy, yudaha na squu ‘tlv gayu,la, uyosdv witsilugo tlawoduhi’nv, dohv? na yagasga, iga na wi-wigalohisdi
segments.translation: It’s no matter where it is, if something is broken. And sometimes it might be somewhere where it’s really muddy. And you really have to go through it even when it’s raining.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮩ’ᎢᏳ’Ꮫ Ꮎ … Ꮎ bulldozer ᏱᎬᏗ, Ꮎ tracks ᏥᏂ,ᏚᏍᏙ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ, ᏙᎩᎭ, ᏙᏆᎴᎳ, Ꮎ bucket truck ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ, Ꮎ … Ꮥ’ᎠᏔ, … ᏱᏫ,ᎦᎶᎯ, ᏝᏬᏚᎯ, ᎠᎴ’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ’Ꮕ, dozer ᏙᏨ,ᏗᎰ ᏍᏊ ᏅᏃᎯ, ᏙᏦ-ᏙᏦᏢᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: do’iyu’dv na … na bulldozer yigvdi, na tracks tsini,dusdo sgi yusdi, dogiha, doqualela, na bucket truck sgi yusdi, na … de’ata, … yiwi,galohi, tlawoduhi, ale’le yigi, na’nv, dozer dotsv,diho squu nvnohi, dotso-dotsotlvsgo
segments.translation: Really. Then we use a bulldozer, the one with tracks on it. That’s the kind we have and it has the bucket on it. It can go through the mud or… Also, we have the dozer that we make roads with.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: Ꭳ ‘Ꮲ Ꮎ’Ꮕ ᏫᏓᏏᎳ,Ꮫ ᏳᏓᎭ ᎢᏭ’Ᏼ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᏙᎲ?
segments.transliteration: o ‘tlv na’nv widasila,dv yudaha iwu’yv yinusdi, dohv?
segments.translation: Oh, that’s right. Sometimes the wires are just right there.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ ᎣᏏ’Ꮫ Ꮩ’ᎢᎭ, ᎤᎾ ᎤᏂᏩᏍᎪ ᎣᎬ,ᏙᏗ,
segments.transliteration: sgi’dv osi’dv do’iha, una uniwasgo ogv,dodi,
segments.translation: Yeah, we do alright. We got all the machinery we need; they buy it.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: What you all use.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎥᎥ yeah, ᎣᏍᏛ Ꭳ’ᎢᏁᎰ ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏗᎦᏌᎴᏂ, Ꮎ’Ꮕ, Ꮩ-Ꮩ’ᎠᏄᏩ, ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏚᏂᏩᏍᎪ ᏍᏊ
segments.transliteration: vv yeah, osdv o’ineho nigada, digasaleni, na’nv, do-do’anuwa, nigada, duniwasgo squu
segments.translation: They take care of us. All the gear/uniforms we wear, they buy it. Yeah, it’s really good working there. They pay for all the insurance.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: That’s good, that’s good.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᎤᏖᏗ,’Ꮫ Ꮧ’ᎠᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ ᎤᎾ insurance ᏍᏊ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏓᎾ,ᏈᏱᏍᎪ (…)--
segments.transliteration: Yeah, utedi,’dv di’alvwi,sdane,di una insurance squu ni’ada, dana,quiyisgo (…)--
segments.translation: Yeah, it’s really good working there. They pay for all the insurance. (…)--

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎮᏍᏗ,’Ꭱ Ꮭ ᏙᏳ ᏍᏓᏱ ᏱᎩ, ᏙᎲ?
segments.transliteration: hesdi,’e tla doyu sdayi yigi, dohv?
segments.translation: And it’s not really hard work, is it?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Uh uh. Not really.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎾ’Ꮎ “ᎣᎩᏁᎰ Ꭼ,--ᎣᎬ,ᏔᏅ” ᏣᏗ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᎯᏗ, ᏂᎬᏁ ᏙᎲ?
segments.transliteration: nana’na “ogineho gv,--ogv,tanv” tsadi sgina ahidi, nigvne dohv?
segments.translation: How about, “They take care of us,” you said. That makes it easier, doesn’t it?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎥᎥ Ꮒ’ᎠᏗ’Ꮕ Ꮎ battery ᏗᎬ,ᏙᏗ, Ꮎ drills Ꮒ’ᎠᏗ’Ꮕ, battery powered ᎨᎰ … Ꭰ’ᎥᏱ ᏣᏩᎴᏅᎲ Ꮎ Ꮎ drill Ꮎ ᎢᎬ,ᏙᏗ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᎤᎾ ᏱᏣ,ᎩᎳ, ᎬᏗ, Ꮎ spikes ᏣᏗᎲ ᏱᏣ,ᎩᎳ, ᎠᎢ ᏱᏂ,ᏨᎿ, … ᏌᏭ ᏳᏩᎦ,Ꮨ, *ᎯᎢ* ᏗᏢ, ᏱᏂ,ᏨᎿ, ᎠᏔᎴᏒ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏱᏅᏁᎲ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ Ꮎ battery-powered ᏃᏭ’Ꮓ
segments.transliteration: vv ni’adi’nv na battery digv,dodi, na drills ni’adi’nv, battery powered geho … a’vyi tsawalenvhv na na drill na igv,dodi, tsi’ehv una yitsa,gila, gvdi, na spikes tsadihv yitsa,gila, ai yini,tsvhna, … sawu yuwaga,ti, *hii* ditlv, yini,tsvhna, atalesv osda, yinvnehv nowu’nv na battery-powered nowu’no
segments.translation: Yeah. Everything’s battery. All the drills, they’re battery-powered. When I first started, the drill wasn’t battery-powered, if you’re up there using the spikes you were talking about, and holding it like this [gestures]. I guess you had to put it this [gestures] way, to fix a hole. Now, we’re using battery-power and it’s faster.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎩᎳ ᎢᏳᏟ,ᏍᏗ, … ᎬᏃᎯᏏ, Ꮎ ᎯᎢ … ᏌᏭ ᏳᏩᎦ,Ꮨ,’Ꭱ Ꮎ VoTech … ᏓᏩᏕᎶ,ᏆᎥ ᎢᎸᏍᎩ ᏃᏥᎡ Henry Sawney ᎨᎸ, Joe Daughtery, Jim Bicks, Jim Pritchett ᏍᎩᎾ. ᎢᎸᏍᎩ,’Ꮫ ᏍᎩ ᏃᏥᎥ -- Adam Doublehead.
segments.transliteration: gila iyutli,sdi, … gvnohisi, na hii … sawu yuwaga,ti,’e na VoTech … dawadelo,quav ilvsgi notsie Henry Sawney gelv, Joe Daughtery, Jim Bicks, Jim Pritchett sgina. ilvsgi,’dv sgi notsiv -- Adam Doublehead.
segments.translation: It’s faster. Let me tell you this, one time, I was going to school at VoTech. There were a few of us, Henry Sawney was there. And Joe Daughtery. Jim Bicks, Jim Pritchett. There were a few of us--Adam Doublehead.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: They’re all gone now. Ain’t it?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Uh uh, all of them…except for Henry.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Just Henry. Henry Sawney!?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah. Henry’s still around.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Him and Jerry Wayne came by here awhile back.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Really?

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Henry

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꭳ ᎥᎥ ᏔᎵ,’Ꮫ ᎠᏁᎯ, Henry Sawney
segments.transliteration: o vv tali,’dv anehi, Henry Sawney
segments.translation: Oh, yeah! There’s two Henry Sawneys.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, yeah, ᎮᎾ, yeah ᎾᎾ Jerry Wayne-Ꭲ ᎾᎥ ᎦᏁᎳ, ᏙᎲ? Ꮎ Henry.
segments.transliteration: Yeah, yeah, hena, yeah nana Jerry Wayne-i nav ganela, dohv? na Henry.
segments.translation: One of them lives by Jerry Wayne, right?

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah, okay.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ Ꮎ … “ᏑᎾᎴ” ᏃᏭ, ᎣᎪᎮᎸ ᎣᎩᏍᏆᏗᏕᎾ, Ꮢ-ᏒᎯᏰ ᎨᎲ … Ꮎ “ᏙᏓᏗᎵᏙᎵ, ᏓᏣᏕᎶ,ᏆᎢ, ᎢᏥᎸᏍᏗ” ᎣᎪᎮᎸ … ᏙᏳ,’Ꮕ, ᏑᎾᎴ ᏄᎵᏍ,ᏔᏅ ᏚᏩᏃᏢ Ꮎ ᏃᎬᏁᎸ (…) “Adam!” Adam Doublehead. “Alright, Adam,” ᎠᎪᎮᎸ ᏃᏭᎴ’Ꮕ ᎤᎯᎸᏒ’Ꮫ “‘ᏢᏴ ᏃᏭ, belt off and then come back down,” ᎠᎪᎮᎸ “Alright, Adam, belt off!” ᎠᎪᎮᎸ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎣᏍᏓ’Ᏼ ᏭᎩᎸ … ᏭᎩᎶ’Ꮫ (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ) “Okay, Adam, belt off!” – “I can’t.”
segments.transliteration: sgi’dv na … “sunale” nowu, ogohelv ogisquadidena, sv-svhiye gehv … na “dodadilidoli, datsadelo,quai, itsilvsdi” ogohelv … doyu,’nv, sunale nulis,tanv duwanotlv na nogvnelv (…) “Adam!” Adam Doublehead. “Alright, Adam,” agohelv nowule’nv uhilvsv’dv “‘tlvyv nowu, belt off and then come back down,” agohelv “Alright, Adam, belt off!” agohelv osda, osda’yv wugilv … wugilo’dv (uyetsi,sgv) “Okay, Adam, belt off!” – “I can’t.”
segments.translation: Yeah, it was him who said, “I’ll see you all tomorrow!” It was almost time to quit working. “We are going to climb around. You all are going to learn to climb!” he said. The morning came; he brought (…) “Adam!” Adam Doublehead. “Alright, Adam,” he said to him. So, he climbed up. “Halfway up there, belt off and then come back down,” he told us. “Alright, Adam, belt off!” he told him. He was quite a ways up there, but he just stayed up there. [laughs] “Okay, Adam, belt off!” [he said.] “I can’t,” Adam said.
[laughter]

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎤᏄᎸᏅ ᎤᎦ,ᏐᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎦᏰᎲᎢ … Ꮎ Mike Glass ᎯᏲᎵᎩᏍᎪ,?
segments.transliteration: unulvnv uga,sohisdi agayehvi … na Mike Glass hiyoligisgo,?
segments.translation: He couldn’t come back down, because he was scared. You know Mike Glass, don’t you?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’Ꭱ ᏧᎯᎸᏒ *ᎯᎢ’Ꮕ* ᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵ,ᏍᏛᏡᏅ Adam ᏕᏥᎦᏐᏔᏅ
segments.transliteration: sgi’e tsuhilvsv *hii’nv* yusdi, uli,sdvtlunv Adam detsigasotanv
segments.translation: He climbed up there. He had Adam sitting like this [gestures] on his shoulders. He brought him back down.
[laughter]

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ ᏄᎾᏍᏗ, ᎤᏠᏱ ᎾᎾᎵ,ᏍᏗᎰ ᎤᎾ ᏦᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ,Ꮧ yeah. … ᎠᏤ ᎮᎾ, ᏚᏃᏢ ᏃᏭ, … Ꮎ “belt off” ᏣᏗ ᏍᎩ’ᎡᏭ ᏌᏭ belt ᏥᏂ,ᎬᏅ … ᎠᎯᏗ,-ᎠᎯᏗ ᎮᎾ, ᎦᎸᏍᏗ, Ꮎ belt *ᎠᎭᏂ,* ᏱᏂ,ᏨᎿ,
segments.transliteration: Yeah, sgi’dv nunasdi, utloyi nanali,sdiho una tsogilvwi,sdane,di yeah. … atse hena, dunotlv nowu, … na “belt off” tsadi sgi’ewu sawu belt tsini,gvnv … ahidi,-ahidi hena, galvsdi, na belt *ahani,* yini,tsvhna,
segments.translation: That’s how some of them get that are working. They made something new now, that “belt off,” you’re talking about. It’s one belt now. It’s easier to climb up with if you have one belt like this [gestures] way.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: It’s better than the other way.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏱᏣᎷᏣ, ᏃᏭ, belt Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏂᎬᎿ ᏐᎢ, ᎮᎾ, ᏂᎬᎿ,’Ꮓ belt, ᏔᎵ, belts Ꮒ,ᏕᎬᎿ, … clamp ᏂᎦᎵ,ᏍᏗᎰ ᏍᎩᎾᎾ ᏱᏣᎶᏌ, Ꮭ ᎮᎾ Ꮭ ᏱᏬᎯᎷᎦ,
segments.transliteration: nowu’nv, yitsalutsa, nowu, belt ni’ada, nigvhna soi, hena, nigvhna,’no belt, tali, belts ni,degvhna, … clamp nigali,sdiho sginana yitsalosa, tla hena tla yiwohiluga,
segments.translation: When you go there, they give you one belt. Now, they have two belts that clamp together. If you’re falling off, you won’t really fall.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: The belt will catch you.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮎ second belt ᏱᏣᏂᏯ, … … Yeah, ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ Ꭼ,ᏙᏗ, ᎨᎰ ᏃᏭ, ᎠᎾ,Ꮮ-- ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, boy, ᎾᎮᎾ, ᎤᏩᏌ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ Ꮜ-ᏌᏭ ᎠᎯᏗ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᎦᎸᏍᏗ ᎯᎢ’Ꮕ, ᏃᏭ, … ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, ᏐᎢ, ᎤᏯᏅ ᏱᏄᏍᏗ, Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏂᏨᏂ,ᏕᏍᏗ, … ᏃᏭ belts, go over the, Ꮎ ᎤᏯᏅ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏂᏨᏂ,ᏙᏗ, ᏱᏣᎷᎦ,
segments.transliteration: na second belt yitsaniya, … … Yeah, ‘ahena, squu gv,dodi, geho nowu, ana,tle-- ‘ahena, boy, nahena, uwasa, tsi’ehv sa-sawu ahidi, tsi’ehv galvsdi hii’nv, nowu, … gohu,sdi, yinusdi, soi, uyanv yinusdi, ni’ada, nitsvni,desdi, … nowu belts, go over the, na uyanv ni’ada, nitsvni,dodi, yitsaluga,
segments.translation: The second belt will catch you. You have to use that now. When it was just one, it was easier to climb with. Now, if there are wires there, you have to take them off. The belts go over the wire and you have to take them all off, and then you climb.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎾ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏕᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎯ ᏱᎪᎯᏓ, Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏣᎪᎲ ᏱᎩ, ᎩᎶ Ꮎ … ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᎤᎵ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ … ᏱᎩ, ᏱᏫᎦᎶᏍᎬ ᎠᎴ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ, ᎤᏩᏂᎲ … Ꮭ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ, ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏣᎪᎲ ᏱᎩ,?
segments.transliteration: nana sgina detsalvwi,sdanehi yigohida, tla ilvhiyu tsagohv yigi, gilo na … gohu,sdi, uli,sdanehv … yigi, yiwigalosgv ale anagalisgi, uwanihv … tla sgi yusdi, gohu,sdi, tsagohv yigi,?
segments.translation: How about in all the time you’ve been working there, have you ever seen anything happen to someone? Like, falling off or getting electrocuted? You haven’t seen anything like that?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮭ’Ᏺ Ꭰ’ᎢᎪᎲ ᏱᎩ, ‘ᎠᎮᎾ ᏌᏭ ᎠᏧᏣ,’Ᏺ … ᏍᎩᎾ ᏧᏒᏂᎸ … *Ꭰ’Ꮒ,’Ꮫ* ᏧᏒᏂᎸ ᏥᏭᏴᏢ *Ꭰ’Ꮒ,* ᏥᏭᎶᏒ *Ꭰ’Ꮒ,* ᏥᏭᏅᎪᏨ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ, … *ᎠᎭᏂ,’Ꮫ* ᎨᎵ *ᎯᎾᎾ* …*ᎯᎢ’Ꮕ,* Ꮭ’Ꮓ ᏱᏕ’ᎠᏰᏌᏛ,’Ꮓ
segments.transliteration: tla’yo a’igohv yigi, ‘ahena sawu atsutsa,’yo … sgina tsusvnilv … *a’ni,’dv* tsusvnilv tsiwuyvtlv *a’ni,* tsiwulosv *a’ni,* tsiwunvgotsv na anagalisgi, … *ahani,’dv* geli *hinana* …*hii’nv,* tla’no yide’ayesadv,’no
segments.translation: No, I haven’t seen anything. Except one of the boys touched a live wire. It went in here [gestures] came through here [gestures] and it came out over here [gestures], the electricity. I think here [gestures] and this one and this one [gestures] he doesn’t have any fingers now.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: It’s surprising what electricity can do.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Really, he should’ve been dead.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: *Unintelligble*

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎡᎵᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, … ᎡᎵᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ᏳᏲᎱᏒ ᎤᏁᎳᏅ ᎮᎾ, Ꭴ-…ᎤᎦ,ᏘᏴ … ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, Ꮟ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᎡᎯ,
segments.transliteration: elisdi, hena, … elisdi, hena, yuyohusv unelanv hena, u-…uga,tiyv … sgi hena, si nowu’nv, ehi,
segments.translation: He should have died. God was watching over him. That’s why he’s still alive.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Isn’t that Teddy Asbill’s brother-in-law?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: That’s him.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: I forgot his name.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ Tim. ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ … Ꮭ ᎮᎾ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎩ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ Ᏹ’ᎡᎮ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎩ, yeah, ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ … ᎤᏩᏏ’Ꮕ, ᏍᏊ ᎤᏩᏂᏌᏗ, ᎨᎲ ᏥᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ … ᎤᏅ,Ꮫ’Ꮕ, Ꮭ ᎮᎾ, ᏱᏚ-- ᎾᎾ ᎠᏭ’Ꮲ Ꮩ’ᎢᎭ, Ꮎ gloves Ꮩ’ᎢᎾᎣ … ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, Ꮔ-- ᎤᏗᏞᎩ, ᏱᎩ, Ꮎ ᎤᏯᏅ Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, Ꮭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, Ᏹ’ᎥᏮᎦ, Ꮎ ᎠᏜ … ᏍᎩᎾ, ᎾᎾ “sleeves” ᏍᏊ ᏙᏦᏎᎰ ᏍᏊ ᎤᎾ,ᏝᎾ, *Ꭰ’Ꮒ,’Ᏼ* ᏗᎦᎷᎦ, ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, Ꮩ’ᎠᏄᏬ ᏍᎩᏭ ᏳᏍᏗ, ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏱᏃᏨᏁ … ᎠᎾ’ᎠᎵᏍᎬ ᏗᎬ,ᏝᏓ, Ꮒ’ᎡᎲᎾ, ᏱᎩ, Ꮩ’ᎢᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ … ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏌᏭ ᏳᏩᎦ,Ꮣ, ᎮᎾ, ᏳᏩᏂᎳ, ᏍᎩᎾᎾ 7200 ᎮᎾ, ᎨᎰ volts.
segments.transliteration: sgi’dv Tim. sgi’dv … tla hena, digalawigi, tsi’ehv yi’ehe ‘ahena, nowu’nv, osda, digalawigi, yeah, sgi’dv tsi’ehv … uwasi’nv, squu uwanisadi, gehv tsinuli,stanv … unv,dv’nv, tla hena, yidu-- nana awu’tlv do’iha, na gloves do’inao … sgi hena, nu-- uditlegi, yigi, na uyanv tla gohu,sdi, sgi hena, tla gohu,sdi, yi’vwvga, na adla … sgina, nana “sleeves” squu dotsoseho squu una,tlana, *a’ni,’yv* digaluga, sgi hena, do’anuwo sgiwu yusdi, osda, yinotsvne … ana’alisgv digv,tlada, ni’ehvna, yigi, do’ilvwi,sdanehv … ‘ahena, sawu yuwaga,da, hena, yuwanila, sginana 7200 hena, geho volts.
segments.translation: That’s him. Tim. That’s him. He didn’t used to go to church, but now he does. Yeah, that was him. It was his own fault, what happened to him. He knew we had some rubber gloves because when the wire is hot, it won’t burn you with those rubber gloves. We called them “sleeves.” They come up to here [gestures], what we wear when we’re working on wires. If the wires are not turned off while we are working. If it hits you one time, it has 7200 volts.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Whew!

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: You’d think…[he would’ve died.] It’s good--

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: --God took care of him.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩᏭ’Ꭱ ᏭᎵ,ᏍᏛ yeah, ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ helicopter-Ꭲ’Ꭱ ᏥᏭᏂᏯᎸᏅ … ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: sgiwu’e wuli,sdv yeah, sgi’dv helicopter-i’e tsiwuniyalvnv … una
segments.translation: He really did. Yeah, that’s right. They called in a helicopter there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Was he on top of the pole when that happened to him?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Huh uh, Ꮎ bucket truck-Ꭲ’Ꭱ ᏧᏣᎥ
segments.transliteration: Huh uh, na bucket truck-i’e tsutsav
segments.translation: No, he was in the bucket truck.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Oh!

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎾᏅ Ꮎ-Ꮎ ᏐᎢ, … ᎤᎩᎸ ᎤᎾ “Turn it on!” Ꮵ’Ꭳ’ᎣᎮᎸ … ᏧᏠᏒ ᎮᎾ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏂᎬᏁᎲ “Go turn it on!” ᏧᏛᏅ’Ꮕ, Ꮎ ᏐᎢ, one pole down ᏭᎷᏨ “I’m gonna turn it on! Tim, get down!” – “Go ahead! Turn it on, I said!” ᎤᏍᎦᎮᏗ, ᎮᎾ, ᏳᏍᏗ, ᎤᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏍᎩᎾᎾ
segments.transliteration: nanv na-na soi, … ugilv una “Turn it on!” tsi’o’ohelv … tsutlosv hena, tsi’ehv osda, nigvnehv “Go turn it on!” tsudvnv’nv, na soi, one pole down wulutsv “I’m gonna turn it on! Tim, get down!” – “Go ahead! Turn it on, I said!” usgahedi, hena, yusdi, uwonihisdi tsigehv sginana
segments.translation: There was another one who was perched on the pole, “Turn it on!” he told us. The power had gone out and he was fixing it. “Go turn it on!” the other one told him. He went one pole down. “I’m gonna turn it on! Tim, get down!” – “Go ahead! Turn it on, I said!” He talked like he was griping all the time.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏥᏲᎵᎦ,’Ꮫ ᎪᎢ ᏥᎦᏁᎸ ᎪᎯᏗ, Ꮭ’Ᏺ ᏃᏭ,
segments.transliteration: tsiyoliga,’dv goi tsiganelv gohidi, tla’yo nowu,
segments.translation: I knew him. He lived in Greasy for a while, but not now.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎠᎭ,Ꮒ,’Ꮫ Hungry Mt. ᏗᏢ, ᎨᎵ ᏙᏳ, ᎤᏪᏅ ᎡᎳᏗ, ᏗᏢ, ᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ ᏣᏗᎲ ᎡᎳᏗ, ᏩᎢᏒ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏫᏅᏮᏁᎳ, up ᏫᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ ᏭᏒᏂᎸ ᏣᏗᎲ Ꮭ ᎮᎾ, Ꮭ ‘ᎣᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏱᏚ-ᏱᏚᎵ,ᏰᏑᎸ ᏍᎩᎾ, … ᎤᎾᎾ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ ᏍᎩ ᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᎾ, Ꮥ’ᎣᏢ ᎡᎳᏗ, ᏗᏢ, Ꮎ controls, ᎡᎳᏗ, Ꮎ’ᎥᏁᎸ Ꮎ bucket-Ꭲ ᎤᏣᎥ ᎦᏳ,Ꮅ’Ꮕ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ C.P.R ᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ--Ꮎ’ᎥᏁᎸ … ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ Ꮽ’ᎣᏛ Ꭰ’Ꭲ’ᎣᎲ ᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: aha,ni,’dv Hungry Mt. ditlv, geli doyu, uwenv eladi, ditlv, nuli,stanv tsadihv eladi, waisv osda, winvwvnela, up winuli,stanv wusvnilv tsadihv tla hena, tla ‘ohu,sdi, yidu-yiduli,yesulv sgina, … unana nowu’nv sgi nuli,stana, de’otlv eladi, ditlv, na controls, eladi, na’vnelv na bucket-i utsav gayu,li’nv nowu’nv C.P.R nuli,stanv--na’vnelv … sgi’dv wu’odv a’i’ohv nuli,stanv una
segments.translation: I think he moved over toward Hungry Mt. He said it went down, while he was walking on foot. When he fixed it, it went up. He touched it and he wasn’t wearing any gloves. When that happened, there are controls to bring it down, and they brought him down. He was in the bucket. Then they had already started doing CPR on him. That’s the most I’ve seen happen there.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You don’t ever worry about that stuff?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Oh, yeah, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎮᎾ, ᎤᎾ ᏱᏗᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎯ, … ‘Ᏺ ᎮᎾ, *ᎯᎢ* ᏱᏣᏛᎿ, ᏕᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏳᏓᎭ Ꮎ …
segments.transliteration: Oh, yeah, nigohilv hena, una yiditsalvwi,sdanehi, … ‘yo hena, *hii* yitsadvhna, detsalvwi,sdanehv yudaha na …
segments.translation: Oh, yeah, all the time. If you were working there, you would be like this [gestures] while you’re working. Sometimes that…

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: You have to really watch what you’re doing, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏦᎢ ᏓᏏᎳ,Ꮫ, “three phase,” ᎠᏃᏎᎰ ᏦᎢ ᏱᏓᏏᎳᏛ, ᎠᎭ,Ꮒ, ᏕᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏳᏗᏞᎩ, … yeah, ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ-ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ “ᏣᎸᏉ,ᏗᏍᎪ,?” Ꮳ-ᏣᏗ, ᎪᎯ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᏍᎩ’Ꭱ Ꮭ ᏯᎩᎸᏉ,Ꮩ
segments.transliteration: tsoi dasila,dv, “three phase,” anoseho tsoi yidasiladv, aha,ni, detsalvwi,sdanehv yuditlegi, … yeah, sgi’dv-sgi’dv “tsalvquo,disgo,?” tsa-tsadi, gohi tsi’ehv sgi’e tla yagilvquo,do
segments.translation: There are three wires. They call it “three phase,” if there are three wires where you are working, when it’s live. That’s what you were asking a while ago, “Do you like it?” I don’t like it.
[Laughter]

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᏙᏳ’Ꮫ I think ᎮᎾ, top 10 dangerous jobs in the world.
segments.transliteration: Yeah, doyu’dv I think hena, top 10 dangerous jobs in the world.
segments.translation: Yeah, really. I think they have it as one of the top ten dangerous jobs in the world.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: That one.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: What I’m doing.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏙᏳ, ᎤᏍᏆᏂᎪ,Ꮧ, ᏙᎯᏳ Ꭰ-ᎠᎦᎾ,ᏰᎩ ᎤᏝᏂᎩᏗ’Ᏼ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ,
segments.transliteration: doyu, usquanigo,di, dohiyu a-agana,yegi utlanigidi’yv anagalisgi,
segments.translation: It’s interesting and scary how powerful electricity is.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Mhm. ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, … ᏃᏭ, … Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, … ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏯᎾ,ᏈᏱ ᏥᏂ,ᎦᏛᏁ
segments.transliteration: Mhm. ‘ahena, … nowu, … tla yawanv,ta, … osda, yana,quiyi tsini,gadvne
segments.translation: Mhm. Now, I don’t know [if] even they are paying good, what I’m doing.
[Laughter]

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: I guess if you be careful all the time.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah. Ꭳ’ᎡᏲᎲᏍᎪ ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏃᎦᏛᏁ,Ꮧ Ꮎ ᎠᏩᎦ,Ꮞ-ᎠᏩᎦ,ᏎᏍᏗ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ monthly meeting Ꮩ’ᎥᏁᎰ … ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏳᎵ,ᏍᏔᎾ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎮᎾ, ᎩᎶ ᎠᏴ’Ꮫ *ᎯᎾᎾ* Ꮭ ᏍᏊ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᎭᏢ, ᏗᏢ, ᎨᎲ *ᎠᎭ,Ꮒ,’Ꮫ* ‘ᎡᎵ Ꮣ’ᎢᏰᏍᏙᏅ about a mon—about a year ago ‘ᎸᏢ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᏣᎩ,ᏍᏆᎵ,Ꮢ *ᎯᎾᎾ* stitches Ꮒ,ᏓᏮᏂ,Ꮫ … Ꮎ ᏐᎢ, ᎠᏧᏣ, ᎤᏩᏌᏙᏴ ‘ᎣᎱ,ᏍᏗ, Ꮣ’ᎢᏰᏍᏙᎥ … ᏍᎩ’ᏭᎡ ᏗᏢ, ‘Ᏺ ᏱᏂ,ᎦᎵ,ᏍᏗᎰ ᏍᏊ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, Ꮩ’ᎢᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ
segments.transliteration: Yeah. o’eyohvsgo nigohilv osda, gohu,sdi, nogadvne,di na awaga,se-awaga,sesdi, nigohilv monthly meeting do’vneho … gohu,sdi, yuli,stana, nigohilv hena, gilo ayv’dv *hinana* tla squu yawanv,ta, hatlv, ditlv, gehv *aha,ni,’dv* ‘eli da’iyesdonv about a mon—about a year ago ‘lvtlv tsi’ehv tsagi,squali,sv *hinana* stitches ni,dawvni,dv … na soi, atsutsa, uwasadoyv ‘ohu,sdi, da’iyesdov … sgi’wue ditlv, ‘yo yini,gali,sdiho squu ni’ada, do’ilvwi,sdanehv
segments.translation: Yeah, and they are teaching us all the time to be doing our work right, be careful all the time. We always have a monthly meeting, when something happens. Every time, somebody… Me, this [gestures]…I don’t know which side, here [gestures], I think. They smashed my fingers, -about a year ago sometime, I broke this [gestures] one. I had stitches. And another boy, because he pushed something, he smashed my fingers. These things happen while we are at work.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You all look after each other?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’ᏭᎡ ᏭᎵ,ᏍᏛ yeah, ᎩᎶ’Ꮫ ᏱᏕᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ … ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, ᏍᏊ ᎮᎾ, ᎦᏙ’Ꭳ ᎤᎾ ᎤᏙᏓᏩᏓ, ᏰᏙᎯ, ᏱᏣᎦ,ᏙᏍᏓ, … ᎾᎥᏂ ᏱᏂ,ᎦᎵ,ᏍᏗ … ᏳᏪᏡᎦ, ᏕᏣᏙᎥ “Hey! … ᎾᎥᎢ ᎯᎷᎦ,” ᎠᎾ,ᏗᎰ y’know. ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏕᎭᏍᏔᏰᏍᎬ’Ᏼ ᏳᏕᎳᎰᏌ, “ᎡᎳᏗ, ᏕᎮᏂ!” ᏯᎾᏓ, … ᏐᎢ, ᏱᏩᏂᏯᎳ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ … “ᎠᎹ, ᏩᏗᏗ!” – “ᎠᏭ ᏫᏦᏞᏍᏗ,!”Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, Ᏺ-ᏲᎪᏌ, ᎮᎾ,
segments.transliteration: sgi’wue wuli,sdv yeah, gilo’dv yidetsalvwi,sdane … sgi hena, squu hena, gado’o una udodawada, yedohi, yitsaga,dosda, … navni yini,gali,sdi … yuwetluga, detsadov “Hey! … navi hiluga,” ana,diho y’know. nowu’nv, dehastayesgv’yv yudelahosa, “eladi, deheni!” yanada, … soi, yiwaniyala tsi’ehv … “ama, wadidi!” – “awu witsotlesdi,!”le yigi, yo-yogosa, hena,
segments.translation: Yeah, really, we do. If you’re working, someone stands there by you all day, watching you. If you’re getting too close to the wire, they’ll yell your name “Hey! You’re getting too close!” they’ll say, y’know. And then if they notice you’re getting tired, they’ll tell you to come down. And they get somebody else. “Go drink some water! Sit over here for a while!” they’ll say.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: They are really watching you all.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎥᎥ Ꮎ ᏧᎧᏏ,Ꮯ, yeah, yeah, … yeah … ᏂᎯ’ᏭᎴ ᏱᎩ, Ᏹ-ᏱᏣᏛᎾ, “Hey, ᏕᎦᏍᏓᏍᏰᏍᎬ,” Ᏹ’ᎡᎯᏲᏎᎳ, … Ꮭ ‘ᎣᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏯᎾᏗ ᎮᎾ, “ᎡᎳᏗ, ᏕᎮᏂ!” ᏯᎾᏓ, … Yeah, and ᎣᏏ’Ꮫ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ, ᏚᏂᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁ ᎤᎾ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꭰ-ᏙᎯᏳ ᎠᏓᏁᏟᏴᎠ, Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᎮᎾ, ᏧᏂ,ᏍᏗᎧᏂ, ᏃᏭ,
segments.transliteration: vv na tsukasi,tli, yeah, yeah, … yeah … nihi’wule yigi, yi-yitsadvna, “Hey, degasdasyesgv,” yi’ehiyosela, … tla ‘ohu,sdi, yanadi hena, “eladi, deheni!” yanada, … Yeah, and osi’dv anitsutsa, dunilvwi,sdane una ‘ahena, a-dohiyu adanetliyva, ni’ada, hena, tsuni,sdikani, nowu,
segments.translation: Yeah, yeah, the boss. Or if you tell the bosses yourself, “Hey, I’m tired.” They won’t say anything, but tell you to come down. Yeah, there’s some good boys working, but it is changing. Now, they are all younger.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: They’re just now learning.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: They’re just now learning. They’re coming now.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎢᏳᏍᏗ’ᏭᏛ ᏥᎩ, ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, ᏄᏍᏗ, ᎭᏢ’Ꮽ ᏥᎩ, ᎯᎢ’Ꮽ, … ᎯᎢ’Ꮽ, ᏍᏊ ᎡᎶᎯ, ᏥᏕᎯ, ᎠᏓᏁᏟᏴᏎᎬ, ᏳᏍᏗ’Ꮽ ᎨᎲ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎾᎾ ᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏏᏄᎦ, Ꮎ ᏥᏣᏛᏒᎢ ᎦᎵ,ᏦᏕ ᏥᏥᏁᎴ ᎤᏔᏂᏍᎪ, ᎦᎵ,ᏦᏕ ᎢᏥᏁᎴ? ᎠᎹᏍᎪ, Ꮒ,ᏚᏍᏕ? ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ,’Ꭸ ᏕᏣᏛᏏᏗᏒ?
segments.transliteration: iyusdi’wudv tsigi, sgi hena, nusdi, hatlv’wu tsigi, hii’wu, … hii’wu, squu elohi, tsidehi, adanetliyvsegv, yusdi’wu gehv sgina nana sgi tsinasinuga, na tsitsadvsvi gali,tsode tsitsinele utanisgo, gali,tsode itsinele? amasgo, ni,dusde? anagalisgi,’ge detsadvsidisv?
segments.translation: Just anything, that’s how it is, no matter where it is. This earth we live on, things are changing. Just anything. Now, let’s back up. When you were growing up, where you lived was a big house? Did it have water and electricity when you were growing up?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎭᏗ ᏌᏭ … ᏍᎩ’ᏭᏛ ᏌᏭ ᎤᏔᎾ, ᏣᏓᏁᎸ ᎤᎾ kitchen ᎾᏅ ᎣᎩᏴᏍᏗ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ … ᎠᏓ,’ᎢᏅ, ᏙᏨ,ᏗᎲ … ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, … ᏌᏭ ᏔᎵ, ᏦᎢ, ᏕᎧᏅᏑᎸ…
segments.transliteration: hadi sawu … sgi’wudv sawu utana, tsadanelv una kitchen nanv ogiyvsdi ni’ada, tsi’ehv … ada,’inv, dotsv,dihv … nowu’nv, … sawu tali, tsoi, dekanvsulv…
segments.translation: No. It was just a big house. We had a kitchen and a big room. We used wood. Then there were one, two, three rooms…

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Your bedrooms?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꭳ’ᎢᏒᏍᏗ ᎤᎾ ᏌᏭ’Ꭱ Ꮭ ᏙᏳ, ᏍᎩ ᎢᎦ … Ꭴ:ᏍᏗ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ … Ꮎ’Ꮕ, newspaper Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏃᏨᏁᎲ ᎤᏴᏟ ᎦᏃᎸᏍᎬ
segments.transliteration: o’isvsdi una sawu’e tla doyu, sgi iga … u:sdi tsi’ehv … na’nv, newspaper ni’ada, notsvnehv uyvtli ganolvsgv
segments.translation: Our bedrooms. One was really small. We put newspaper on the walls because of the cold wind blowing in.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Or cardboard, right?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah, we would put that on there.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ‘Ꮩ-‘Ꮩ ᎠᎾ,ᏛᏁ ᎨᎮ ᏗᏣᎦᏴᎵᎨ ᎾᎯᏳ ᎢᏣᎵ,ᏍᏕᎸ,ᏙᏗ, ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ,?
segments.transliteration: ‘do-‘do ana,dvne gehe ditsagayvlige nahiyu itsali,sdelv,dodi, gohu,sdi,?
segments.translation: What did your parents do to live on?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎭᏛ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ ᏥᏲᎵᎦ, ᏱᎨᎮ Ꭰ’ᎢᏙᏓ, Ꮭ ᎢᎸᎯᏳ Ꮵ’ᎣᎥ ᏱᎩ, Ꮭ ᏍᏊ-- ᎨᎵ’Ꮫ ᎠᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᎨᎲ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꮭ ᏙᏳ, ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ,
segments.transliteration: hadv ilvhiyu tsiyoliga, yigehe a’idoda, tla ilvhiyu tsi’ov yigi, tla squu-- geli’dv awanv,ta, gehv ‘ahena, tla doyu, yawanv,ta,
segments.translation: I never knew my dad. I never saw him. And also, I think I know who he was, but I’m not sure.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: How about your mother?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ‘Ꮲ--‘Ꮲ ᎤᎾᎾ Stilwell Food’s ᏗᏢ, Ꭰ--ᏧᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎯ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ … Ꮎ’Ꮫ Ꮵ,ᏈᏍᏗ, Ꭴ--ᏧᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᏥᎨᎲ ᎤᎾᎾ Bell-Ꭲ ᎠᏓᏍᏓᏴᏍᎪ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᏍᏊ
segments.transliteration: Yeah, ‘tlv--‘tlv unana Stilwell Food’s ditlv, a--tsulvwi,sdanehi, tsi’ehv … na’dv tsi,quisdi, u--tsulvwi,sdanehi, tsigehv unana Bell-i adasdayvsgo tsi’ehv squu
segments.translation: She worked at the Stilwell Food’s. She worked at a lot of places. She used to be the cook at Bell [School].

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: She sure was a hard worker.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎩᎶ … ᎣᏣᏝᏅᏢ Ꮎ’Ꮕ, ᎤᎾ ᎮᎾ, ᏧᎾ,ᏕᎶ,ᏆᏍᏗ … principal Buck Eads ᎮᎾ, ᏧᏙᎢᏓ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, Ꮎ rent houses ᏥᏂ,ᏚᏮᏅ ᏅᎩ, ᏓᏓᏁᎸ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏧᏠᏱ ᎤᎾ Duncanville ᎤᏃᏎᏗ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ (ᎤᏂᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ) ᎣᏤᎲ ᎤᎾ ᏍᎩᎾ, ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏗᏂᏲᏟ, ᎮᎾ, Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ᏓᏁᎲ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, … ᏍᎩ ᎮᎾ, ᏍᎩ’ᏭᏛ Ꮒ’ᎠᏓ, ‘Ꮫ-‘Ꮫ-‘Ꮧ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᎰᏩ’Ᏺ ‘ᎣᎱ,ᏍᏗ, Ᏺ’ᎢᎲ ᏗᏁᎶ,ᏙᏗ, ᎨᎲ Ꭳ’Ꭵ-Ꭳ’ᎥᏌ, ᎮᎾ, ᎣᏦᏢᏍᎬ … ᎣᏥᏃᎭᎵᏙᎲ’Ꮕ axe’ᎢᏭᎡ Ꮎ ᏲᏥᏂᏙᎯ, ᏳᏓᎭ ᏥᎨᎲ ᏌᎶᎵ, Ᏻ-Ᏻ-ᏱᏭᎸᏓ, ᎡᏡ,Ꭼ ᎣᏥᎴᏴᏍᏗᎲ … ᏅᏱ ᎬᏗ, ᏙᏨᏂᎲ ᏙᏥᎯᎲ
segments.transliteration: nigohilv gilo … otsatlanvtlv na’nv, una hena, tsuna,delo,quasdi … principal Buck Eads hena, tsudoida, tsi’ehv sgi hena, na rent houses tsini,duwvnv nvgi, dadanelv ni’ada, tsutloyi una Duncanville unosedi, tsi’ehv (uniyetsi,sgv) otsehv una sgina, nigada, diniyotli, hena, ni’ada, danehv ni’ada, … sgi hena, sgi’wudv ni’ada, ‘dv-‘dv-‘di yawanv,ta, howa’yo ‘ohu,sdi, yo’ihv dinelo,dodi, gehv o’v-o’vsa, hena, otsotlvsgv … otsinohalidohv’nv axe’iwue na yotsinidohi, yudaha tsigehv saloli, yu-yu-yiwulvda, etlu,gv otsileyvsdihv … nvyi gvdi, dotsvnihv dotsihihv
segments.translation: There was always one of our family, at school. The principal, his name was Buck Eads. He had rental houses, four houses. They all were the same. They used to call it Duncanville. [laughter] We all lived there. Even all the children. We hardly had anything to play with. We just made up our own toys. When we went hunting, all we had was an axe. If we found a squirrel and it went up a tree, we’d cut the tree down. Then we’d hit it with rocks to kill it.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏍᎩᎾᎲ Ꮎ ᎢᏡ,Ꭼ ᏳᏴᏝ, Ꮭ ᏱᏕᏥᎦᏒᏍᏗᎮ?
segments.transliteration: sginahv na itlu,gv yuyvtla, tla yidetsigasvsdihe?
segments.translation: What if it went in the tree, you all didn’t smoke it out?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᎤᏔᎾ ᏱᎩ, ᏍᎩᎾ ᏦᏣᏁᎵ,ᏗᎲ ᎠᎬᏱ … ᏃᏭ, ᎣᏥᎵᎬ’Ꮽ, ᏃᏭ, ᏠᎨᏏ, (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ)
segments.transliteration: Yeah, utana yigi, sgina tsotsaneli,dihv agvyi … nowu, otsiligv’wu, nowu, tlogesi, (uyetsi,sgv)
segments.translation: Yeah, if it was big, that’s what we’d try, first. Then we’d catch the fields on fire. [laughter]

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ‘ᏲᏛ ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ, ᏣᎩᏰᏥ,ᏍᏗ, ᏯᏩᏛᏁᎳ, ᏙᏳ ᏍᎩᎾᎾ(35:15) ᏳᏦᏔᎾ, ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏱᏩᎪᏛ
segments.transliteration: ‘yodv sgi yusdi, tsagiyetsi,sdi, yawadvnela, doyu sginana yutsotana, nigada, yiwagodv
segments.translation: Just like this grass here, if you have a little spark and blow on it, it’ll really burn.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Yeah, ᏐᎭᏫᏂ, ᎠᎪᎲᏍᎬ, ᎥᎥ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, Ꮎ ᏌᎷᏱ ᏱᏫ,ᎦᎵᎦ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ’Ꮓ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, firetruck ᏍᏗᎩᏓ, ᎣᏥᏁᎫᏥᏛ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᎦᏛᏍᎬ ᎤᎾᎲ ᏃᏭ’Ꭱ Bell-Ꭲ’Ꮕ, ᏍᏊ ᎩᎶ ᏱᏯᏛᏛᎾ, Bell-Ꭲ ᏱᏘᎶᏏ “Boy, Ꮭ ᏱᏣᏚᎵ ᏒᏃᏱ ᎾᎥ ᏫᏣᎶᎯᏍᏗ” ᎠᎾᏗᎰ … Halloween ᏱᎩ, ᏙᏥᎴᏴᏍᏗᎲ Ꮎ ᏕᏡᎬ ᏅᏃᎯ, … ᎤᏬᎵ,Ꮧ’Ꭾ Ꮎ ᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᎩᎴᏴᏍᏓ’Ꮫ Ꮎ ᏓᏏᎳ,Ꮫ Ꮩ’ᎢᏲᏍᏔᏅ
segments.transliteration: Yeah, sohawini, agohvsgv, vv nowu’nv, na saluyi yiwi,galiga, tsi’ehv’no nowu’nv, firetruck sdigida, otsinegutsidv, tsi’ehv gadvsgv unahv nowu’e Bell-i’nv, squu gilo yiyadvdvna, Bell-i yitilosi “Boy, tla yitsaduli svnoyi nav witsalohisdi” anadiho … Halloween yigi, dotsileyvsdihv na detlugv nvnohi, … uwoli,di’he na ganvdadisgo ogileyvsda’dv na dasila,dv do’iyostanv
segments.translation: Yeah, underneath it’s burning up. Then the woods will catch on fire. Then a fire truck will come. We were a little mean when I was growing up there in Bell. If you ask somebody, if you’re going to go through Bell, they will tell you “You don’t want to walk through there at night.” On Halloween, we’d lay down trees by the road side. I remember it was funny when we cut trees down, they landed on a fence and tore it up.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Ooh!

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: [laughs]

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꮎ’Ꮫ Ꮎ ᎠᎾᎦᎵᏍᎩ, ᏓᏲᎬ Ꮎ *spark* Ꮒ,ᏕᎦᎵ,ᏍᏗᎲ
segments.transliteration: na’dv na anagalisgi, dayogv na *spark* ni,degali,sdihv
segments.translation: The electric line broke and it was sparking.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’ᏛᎮ Ꮎ ᏕᏥᏲᏍᏔᏂᏙᎴ ᏙᏱ ᎣᏍᏓ ᏧᏅᏁ,Ꮧ
segments.transliteration: sgi’dvhe na detsiyostanidole doyi osda tsunvne,di
segments.translation: I guess you were the one that broke the electric lines so they can fix them!

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎥᎥ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᎤᎾ ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎠ, ᎤᎾ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᎩᎳ’ᏭᏛ ᏃᏭ, spotlight ᎯᎪᏩ,ᏘᎲ Ꮎ … orange’ᎮᎾ, Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ Ꮎ Ꮧ--ᏧᎾ,ᏦᏙᏗ, (R.E.A?)
segments.transliteration: vv nowu’nv, una dagilvwi,sdanea, una nowu’nv, gila’wudv nowu, spotlight higowa,tihv na … orange’hena, tsi’ehv na di--tsuna,tsododi, (R.E.A?)
segments.translation: Yeah, now I’m working on them! And now you see a spotlight. The trucks used to be orange, [R.E.A.?] (Rural Electric Association)

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah, I remember now.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Buster…Buster Woodruff ᏧᏙᎢᏓ,’ᏛᎡ … ᎦᏅᏓᏗᏍᎪ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎾᏅᏁᎰ y’know.
segments.transliteration: Buster…Buster Woodruff tsudoida,’dve … ganvdadisgo osda, nanvneho y’know.
segments.translation: Buster…Buster Woodruff was his name. I remember them fixing it, y’know.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: What happened that you wanted to work in that field?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ‘ᏛᎡ ᏍᎩ ᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ’ᏭᏛ Ꮭ-…Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮫ ᏍᎩ ᎾᏩᏛᏁ,Ꮧ, ᏯᏩᏚᎵᎲ ᎠᏩᏅ,Ꮫ’Ᏺ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎠᎾ,ᏈᏱᏍᎬ ᏍᎩ’ᏃᎡ ᏍᎩᎾ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᎠᎾ,ᏈᏱᏍᎬ ᏯᏩᎴᏅᎭ, Ꮭ--Ꮭ’Ꮓ ᎦᏄᎳ Ꭰ’ᎢᎦᎵ,ᏍᏗ, ᏱᎨᎰ let’s see ᎦᎵ,ᏆᏚ’ᏛᎸᏢ ᏂᎦ ᏓᎩᎲ ᎦᏄᎳ ᏕᏥᎦᎵᏍᎬ ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏗᎦᏚᎲ Ꮒ’ᎣᎯᎸ Ꮵ’ᎡᎲ ᏍᎩ’Ꮕ, ᎧᏁᏍᎩ’Ꮕ, ᏍᏊ ᏥᎾ,ᏏᏁᏍᎬ ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏍᎩᎾᎾ Ꮳ--Ꮎ ᏣᏩᎴᏅᎲ ᏃᏭ, ᏓᎩᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲ ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏓᎩ,ᏑᎵ,ᎪᏨ … ᏓᏤᏢ ᎪᏢᏍᎬ ᎠᏕᎳ, … Ꮟ’ᎡᏲ ᏐᎢ, ᏌᏭ Ꮟ ᎠᎩᎭ, Ꭶ-- Ꮎ ᎦᏄᎳ ᏣᎩᎦᎵ,Ꮢ let’s see about … 25 years’Ꮫ ‘ᎸᏢ ᏂᏥᎦᎵ,ᏍᎬ ᎤᎾ … Spade Mt. ᏧᎾ,ᏓᏂᏐᏗ ᎤᎾ ᏥᎦᎵ,ᏍᎪ
segments.transliteration: ‘dve sgi nuli,stanv’wudv tla-…tla yawanv,dv sgi nawadvne,di, yawadulihv awanv,dv’yo osda, ana,quiyisgv sgi’noe sgina osda, ana,quiyisgv yawalenvha, tla--tla’no ganula a’igali,sdi, yigeho let’s see gali,quadu’dvlvtlv niga dagihv ganula detsigalisgv nigada, digaduhv ni’ohilv tsi’ehv sgi’nv, kanesgi’nv, squu tsina,sinesgv nowu’nv, sginana tsa--na tsawalenvhv nowu, dagilvwi,sdanehv nigada, dagi,suli,gotsv … datsetlv gotlvsgv adela, … si’eyo soi, sawu si agiha, ga-- na ganula tsagigali,sv let’s see about … 25 years’dv ‘lvtlv nitsigali,sgv una … Spade Mt. tsuna,danisodi una tsigali,sgo
segments.translation: It just happened. I don’t know. I didn’t know if I wanted to do that kind of work, but I knew the pay was good. When they started paying well, I didn’t have to mow/cut grass anymore. I had about 17 customers in town that I mowed grass for. I was going all the time. And I was also hauling hay. So when I started working where I’m at now, I quit all the rest. I was making more money. I have one place I mow grass for, still. Let’s see, I’ve been cutting the grass there for 25 years, Spade Mt. Cemetery. I mow the grass there.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: You’re doing important work.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎤᏔᎾ,’Ꭱ ᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᏅ ᎠᎩ,ᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ, ᎠᎩ,ᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ ᏃᏭ, Ꮎ’Ꭱ ᏗᏦᏙᏗ, ᏙᎩᏂᎰ Ꮎ ᎠᏕᏲᎯ, ᎤᏩᏌ, ᏦᎢ, Ꮩ’ᎢᏂᎭ, ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏔᎵ, ᏙᏍᏛ,ᏗᎰ Ꮟ ᏦᎢ,--ᏦᎢ, ᎠᏰᏟ’ᎸᏢ hours ᎠᏟᎯᎵ,ᏙᎰ
segments.transliteration: utana,’e nuli,stanv agi,sdayvhvsgi, agi,sdelisgo nowu, na’e ditsododi, doginiho na adeyohi, uwasa, tsoi, do’iniha, ‘ahena, tali, dosdv,diho si tsoi,--tsoi, ayetli’lvtlv hours atlihili,doho
segments.translation: It has gotten big, my wife helps me now. We use riding mowers. The ones that spin turn. We have three of those. We use two of them. And it still takes us about three and half hours to do.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Ooh!

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: We could cut grass all day, if we had the time.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎾᎾ ‘Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ, ᎭᏛᏁᎰ ᏂᏗᏣᎸᏫ,ᏍᏓᏁᎲᎾ, ᏱᎩ, Ꮭ ᏯᏃᎭᎵᏙᎯ, ᏯᏑᏂᏙᎯ, ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ,’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, ᎰᏢᏅᏍᎩ ᏱᎩ,? ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏍᎩ ᏳᏍᏗ,
segments.transliteration: nana ‘do usdi, hadvneho niditsalvwi,sdanehvna, yigi, tla yanohalidohi, yasunidohi, gohu,sdi,’le yigi, hotlvnvsgi yigi,? gohu,sdi, sgi yusdi,
segments.translation: How about outside of work, what do you do? Do you hunt, fish, or do any crafts? Things like that.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: I have cows.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Oh!

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: 25’Ꮫ ᏕᏥᎾᏝ ᏩᎧ, ᏔᎵ, Ꮔ--ᏄᏓᎴ Ꮣ’Ꭲ’ᎠᎭ, ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᎾᏍᎩᎾ, ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᎮᎾ, ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, Ꮎ ᏓᏐᏴ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏂᎬᏁᎲ ᏠᎨᏏ, ᏕᎨᏠᎰ
segments.transliteration: 25’dv detsinatla waka, tali, nu--nudale da’i’aha, ‘ahena, nasgina, nigohilv hena, gohu,sdi, na dasoyv osda, nigvnehv tlogesi, degetloho
segments.translation: I have 25 cows. Two different breeds. I’m always fixing fences and feeding them.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: Yeah, the cows are going to make you work, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᎩ’ᏭᎡ ᏭᎵ,ᏍᏛ ᏍᎩᎮᎾ, ᏭᎪᏛ ᎦᏛᏁᎰ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꮟ ᏍᏗᎩᏗ’ᏭᎡ ᎣᏥᏃᎭᎵᏙᎰ Ꮎ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ, ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏦᎢ, … ᎦᏙᎯ, Ꮶ’ᎢᏩᏒ Ꭳ’Ꭲ--Ꭳ’Ꭲ--Ꭳ’ᎢᏃᎭᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾ about 4 miles ᎤᎾ ᎠᏓᏁᎸ Crow Hollow ᏣᎾ,ᏗᎰ ᎤᎾ Ꭳ’Ꭲ-Ꭳ’Ꭲ-Ꭳ’ᎢᏩᏒ ᎦᏙᎯ, ᏌᎷᏱ’Ꮥ ᎤᏖᏗ, ᎦᏃᎭᎵᏓᏍᏗ ᎤᎾ
segments.transliteration: sgi’wue wuli,sdv sgihena, wugodv gadvneho ‘ahena, si sdigidi’wue otsinohalidoho na anitsutsa, nigada, tsoi, … gadohi, tso’iwasv o’i--o’i--o’inohalidasdi una about 4 miles una adanelv Crow Hollow tsana,diho una o’i-o’i-o’iwasv gadohi, saluyi’de utedi, ganohalidasdi una
segments.translation: They sure will. I do a lot of that but I still hunt a little bit with the boys. All three boys and I bought some land to hunt on. About four miles from the house, they call it Crow Hollow. That’s where we bought some land or woods. It’s a really good place to hunt.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Did you kill a big one there?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Ꭱ Ꮭ ᏍᏊ ᏱᏫ,ᎨᏓ, (ᎤᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ) ᏍᎩ’Ꮫ Ꮵ’ᎠᏗᎲ ᏄᏓᎵᎭ Ꮭ ᏍᏊ -- ᏂᎪᎯᎸ ᏑᎾᎴ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, ᏱᏫ,ᏕᏥᏃᎭᎵᏙᎳ, Ᏹ’ᎡᎵ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, … ᏩᎧ,’Ꮫ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ, Ꭰ’Ꭲ ᏗᏢ, ‘ᏛᎮ ᏃᏭ ᎪᎱ,ᏍᏗ,’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, ᎠᎾ,ᏕᎲᏍᎬ Ꮎ’Ꮫ ᎠᏂᏓ,’Ꮫ ᏯᎾ,ᏕᎲᏍᎬ, Ꮭ ᎰᏩ ᏱᏫ,ᏥᎷᎪ ᏱᏫ,ᎨᏙᎰ ‘ᎸᏢ … ᏕᎦᎦ,ᏎᏍᏙ
segments.transliteration: e tla squu yiwi,geda, (uyetsi,sgv) sgi’dv tsi’adihv nudaliha tla squu -- nigohilv sunale gohu,sdi, yiwi,detsinohalidola, yi’eli ‘ahena, … waka,’dv gohu,sdi, a’i ditlv, ‘dvhe nowu gohu,sdi,’le yigi, ana,dehvsgv na’dv anida,’dv yana,dehvsgv, tla howa yiwi,tsilugo yiwi,gedoho ‘lvtlv … degaga,sesdo
segments.translation: Eh, I didn’t even go. That’s what I’m saying, I just go sometimes. In the morning, when I plan to go hunt, then there’s something going on with the cows. They’re getting out, or giving birth. When they are giving birth to a calf, I hardly go there [hunting]. I just stay and watch the cows.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.text: ᎩᎵ’Ꮕ, ᏍᏊ--ᎩᎵ’Ꮕ, ᏍᏊ ᎤᏴᏟ’Ᏼ ᎠᎦᏍᎬ, ᏂᎬᏩ,ᏍᏙ ᎩᎳ,
segments.transliteration: gili’nv, squu--gili’nv, squu uyvtli’yv agasgv, nigvwa,sdo gila,
segments.translation: That’s when that happens, when it’s cold and raining.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: They’ll start, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: …something will go wrong, ain’t it?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏳᏓᎵᎭ ᎨᏥᏍᏕᎸ,Ꮧ, ᎨᎰ … ᏱᏫ,ᏕᏥᏴᏓ, ᎨᎰ ᏃᏭ, ᎠᏩᏕᎶ,ᏆᎥ’Ꮓ ᎠᏮᏌ, ᏥᏍᏕᎸ,Ꮧ ᏩᎧ, ᎠᏕᎲᏍᎬ ᎠᎩᎾ,
segments.transliteration: yudaliha getsisdelv,di, geho … yiwi,detsiyvda, geho nowu, awadelo,quav’no awvsa, tsisdelv,di waka, adehvsgv agina,
segments.translation: Sometimes I have to help them. I’ll take them inside somewhere. I have learned it by myself, helping deliver a calf.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: Ꭲ-Ꭲ-ᎢᎦ--ᎦᏌᏙᏯ,ᏍᎬ ᏳᎴᏅᎭ, Ᏺ-ᏲᏐᏅ ᎢᎦ ᎤᏝᏂᎩᏓ, ᏍᏓᏯ Ꭰ-Ꭰ-ᎠᏂᏱ,Ꮧ ᏙᎲ?
segments.transliteration: i-i-iga--gasadoya,sgv yulenvha, yo-yosonv iga utlanigida, sdaya a-a-aniyi,di dohv?
segments.translation: When it starts pushing, and you’ve got your hand inside, it grabs you hard.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏍᏊ’Ꮫ Ꮎ ᎠᎬᏱ ᎡᎵᏍᏗ, ᎮᎾ, Ꭰ’ᎥᏱ ᏗᏢ ᏚᎳᏌᏛ’Ꭱ ᎢᏗᎲ ᎠᎬᏱ … ᏍᎩ’Ꮽ Ꮎ … chain Ꮣ’ᎢᎭ, … ᎾᏅ comealong ᎬᏗ, ᏍᏗᎩᏗ, pressure ᏱᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᎾ,’Ꮓ ᏳᏑᎵ,ᎪᏣ, ᎯᎦᏘᏲ’Ꮓ ᏩᎧ, ᎦᏌᏙᏯ,ᏍᎬ ᏃᏭ ᎡᎳ,Ꮧ,-ᎡᎳ,Ꮧ, ᏗᏢ, ᏣᏌᏙᏯ,ᏍᏗ, ᎨᎰ ᎡᎳᏗ, ᏗᏢ, ᎮᎾ, ᎦᏅᎪᎪ … ᎢᎦᏓ, ᎮᎾ, Ꭴ--ᏍᎩ ᎠᏁᎵᏍᎪ ᏥᏳᎪ,Ꮧ’Ꮽ ᎦᏅᎪᏍᎬ ‘ᎠᎮᎾ, ᎡᎳᏗ, ᏗᏢ,’Ꭱ ᏗᏢ, ᏕᎦᏅᎪ’Ꭳ … ᎠᎬᏱ ᏗᏢ, ᏚᎳᏍᎬ ᎠᏍᎪᎵ’Ꮕ, ᏙᏳ, Ꮿ-Ꮿ-ᏯᏕᏯᎦ,
segments.transliteration: squu’dv na agvyi elisdi, hena, a’vyi ditlv dulasadv’e idihv agvyi … sgi’wu na … chain da’iha, … nanv comealong gvdi, sdigidi, pressure yinuli,stana,’no yusuli,gotsa, higatiyo’no waka, gasadoya,sgv nowu ela,di,-ela,di, ditlv, tsasadoya,sdi, geho eladi, ditlv, hena, ganvgogo … igada, hena, u--sgi anelisgo tsiyugo,di’wu ganvgosgv ‘ahena, eladi, ditlv,’e ditlv, deganvgo’o … agvyi ditlv, dulasgv asgoli’nv, doyu, ya-ya-yadeyaga,
segments.translation: Sometimes, they come out legs-first. I have a chain and a comealong. And when the pressure stops, you just wait on her. While she’s pushing, you need to push her at the bottom. That’s where it comes out. Some people think that it comes straight out. But it comes out of the bottom. If it comes leg-first then its head, it’ll turn.

segments.speaker: michael-cooksey
segments.translation: Huh.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎠᏴ, ᎠᎬᏱ … ᎯᏲᎵᎬ, ᎨᎲ Dirththrower Vann?
segments.transliteration: ayv, agvyi … hiyoligv, gehv Dirththrower Vann?
segments.translation: The first time… You knew Dirtthrower Vann?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Not really. But I have heard people talking about Dirtthrower.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᎾᎾᎭ Roger? Jim Vann ᏍᎩᎾ, ᏳᏍᏗ
segments.transliteration: nanaha Roger? Jim Vann sgina, yusdi
segments.translation: What about Roger? Or Jim Vann?

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: Oh, yeah! Yeah, ᎦᏥᏲᎵᎬ,’Ꮫ Jim, Roger-Ꭲ’Ꮕ,
segments.transliteration: Oh, yeah! Yeah, gatsiyoligv,’dv Jim, Roger-i’nv,
segments.translation: Oh, yeah! Yeah, I knew them, Jim and Roger.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.text: ᏥᏚᎾᏝᎥ’Ꮫ Ꮎ Dirththrower … ᏌᏭ ᏳᏩᎦ,Ꮣ, … ᎠᏓᏁᎸ ᎣᏂ, ᏗᏢ, pond-Ꭲ ᎾᎥ ᏥᎦᏅ,Ꭼ’Ꮽ ᏩᎧ, ᏍᎩᎾ, ᏥᏄᎸᎲᏍᎬ … “ᏱᏍᎩ,ᏍᏕᎵᏍᎪ,?” ᎠᏬᎮᎸ “ᎦᎾ,ᏌᏁᏍᏗ ᎮᎾ, ᎨᎮᏍᏗ” ᎠᏬᎮᎸ ᏙᏳ’Ꮕ, ᎠᎩ,ᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎩ ᎡᏧᎳ, ᎣᎩᏁᎾ, ᎤᎾ ᏗᏢ, ᎩᎵ’Ꮕ, ᎠᎬᏱ ᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛᏁᎲ … ᏥᎾ,ᏏᏁᏍᎬ Ꮎ *slurp noise* ᏣᏗᎰ ᏳᏍᏗ, “[ᏚᎩ,ᏍᏗ ᏧᏤᎸ]” ᏫᎦᏗᎰ’Ꮫ (ᎤᏂᏰᏥ,ᏍᎬ)
segments.transliteration: tsidunatlav’dv na Dirththrower … sawu yuwaga,da, … adanelv oni, ditlv, pond-i nav tsiganv,gv’wu waka, sgina, tsinulvhvsgv … “yisgi,sdelisgo,?” awohelv “gana,sanesdi hena, gehesdi” awohelv doyu’nv, agi,sdayvhvsgi etsula, oginena, una ditlv, gili’nv, agvyi sgi nigadvnehv … tsina,sinesgv na *slurp noise* tsadiho yusdi, “[dugi,sdi tsutselv]” wigadiho’dv (uniyetsi,sgv)
segments.translation: He had cows, Dirtthrower. One time, there behind the house was a pond where a cow was laying. She was having a hard time. “Can you help me?” he asked. “We’re going to have to pull it out,” he said. Both my wife and I went. That was the first time I did that. I was pulling it, [slurp noise] “[Retching Noise]” I was saying. [laughter]

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah, it smells sometimes.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You get used to it, though.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.translation: Yeah.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: You get used to it.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᏄᏓᎭ ᎮᎾ, ᏯᏕᎲᎦ, ᏌᏭ … ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏯᏕᎲᎦ, ᎠᎩᎾ, … ᎠᎮᎾ, Ꮎ ᎤᏕᏅ Ꮟ Ꮎ … ‘Ꮫ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, Ꮿ--ᎤᏃᏎᏗ, Ꮎ bag
segments.transliteration: nudaha hena, yadehvga, sawu … osda, yadehvga, agina, … ahena, na udenv si na … ‘dv yawanv,ta, ya--unosedi, na bag
segments.translation: Sometimes one is born, it will be born well. But the - I don’t know what to call it. The bag.

segments.speaker: charlie-shell
segments.translation: “Utsotanv(i)” Afterbirth.

segments.speaker: randy-duncan
segments.text: ᎤᏦᏔᏅᎢ, ᏐᎭᏫᏂ, Ꮟ ᎦᎸ … ᏍᎩ ᏄᏓᎵᎭ ᏔᎵ ᏦᎢ’Ꮄ ᏱᎩ, … days ᏱᏥᎦᏘᏯ, ᎤᏩᏌ, ᎤᎶᎯᏍᏗ ᎠᎮᎾ, ᏄᏓᎭ ᏍᎩ ᏱᏂ,’ᎥᏛᎦ, ᏃᏭ ᏥᏴᏗᏍᎪ Ꮎ glove … *ᎠᎭᏂ,’Ᏼ* ᏭᎶᎯᏍᏗ, … ᏱᏣᏩᏛᎭ,’Ꮕ, ᎤᏠᏱ ᎯᎢ button ᏥᏂ,ᏕᎬᎿ, ᏳᏍᏗ, Ꮒ,ᏕᎬᎿ ᏐᎭᏫᏂ, ᎤᎾ ᏍᎩ ᏗᏣᏩᏛᏗ, … ᏍᎩᎾ, ᏗᏨᏅ,ᏕᏌ,’Ꮓ ᏱᎾ,ᏏᏁᎦ, ᏂᎦᏓ, ᏃᏭ’Ꮕ, ᏅᏬᏘ, ᏓᎩᎰ ᎤᎾ ᏫᏕᏥᎸᏍᎪ ᏯᎩ,ᏍᏆᏓ, ᎣᏏ--ᎾᎾ ᎣᏍᏓ, ᏱᎾᎾᎵ,ᏍᏓ, … ᏍᏗᎩᏓ, ᏍᏗᎩᏛ’Ꭱ Ꮎ … ‘breedback’ ᎾᎾ,ᏛᏁᎰ ᎪᎯ ᎤᎪᏗ, Ꮿ-…ᏯᎦ,ᏘᏯ, ᏍᎩ ᏱᏄᎵ,ᏍᏔᎾ, … Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅ,Ꮤ, ᏄᏰᏍ--ᏄᏰᎵ,Ꮫ
segments.transliteration: utsotanvi, sohawini, si galv … sgi nudaliha tali tsoi’le yigi, … days yitsigatiya, uwasa, ulohisdi ahena, nudaha sgi yini,’vdvga, nowu tsiyvdisgo na glove … *ahani,’yv* wulohisdi, … yitsawadvha,’nv, utloyi hii button tsini,degvhna, yusdi, ni,degvhna sohawini, una sgi ditsawadvdi, … sgina, ditsvnv,desa,’no yina,sinega, nigada, nowu’nv, nvwoti, dagiho una widetsilvsgo yagi,squada, osi--nana osda, yinanali,sda, … sdigida, sdigidv’e na … ‘breedback’ nana,dvneho gohi ugodi, ya-…yaga,tiya, sgi yinuli,stana, … tla yawanv,ta, nuyes--nuyeli,dv
